description: As High Priest Raimund requested, go to the Ruins of Despair, defeat the departed spirits of priests, and collect 12 Einhasad crucifixes.

name: Einhasad's Crucifix
description: A holy symbol of Einhasad, the goddess of light. Collect 12 of these and go to High Priest Raimund.

name: Gludio Guard's 2nd Badge
description: The mark that distinguishes guard membership. As Captain Bezique requested, hunt giant spiders.

name: Poison Spider Leg
description: A severed leg of a dead poison spider. Collect twenty of these and go to Captain Bezique.

name: Einhasad's 2nd Temple Badge
description: As High Priest Levian requested, kill Langk lizardmen and collect the proof.

name: Lizardman's Totem
description: A small sculpture Langk lizardmen carry with them. Collect twenty of these and take them to High Priestess Levian.

name: Gludio Guard's 3rd Badge
description: A mark that proves guard membership. As Captain Gilbert requested, hunt giant spiders.

name: Giant Spider's Husk
description: The husk of a giant spider that you peeled off. Collect twenty of these and take them to Captain Gilbert.

name: Einhasad's 3rd Temple Badge
description: As High Priest Biotin requested, hunt silent horrors in the Elven Ruins.

name: Skull of Silent Horror
description: The skull of a long-dead Elf. Collect 10 and take them to High Priest Biotin.

name: Bezique's Letter
description: Captain Bezique's letter to Neti. Find Neti in the Village of Gludin and give her the letter.

name: Spartoi's Bones
description: Undead bone pieces. Collect 10 and take them to Neti.

name: Horseshoe of Light
description: A proof you received after passing Neti's test. You must take it to Captain Bezique.

name: Most Wanted List
description: It is written that whoever does away with the Cat's Eye bandits and recovers the stolen goods will be rewarded.

name: Stolen Jewelry
description: A fair amount of jewelry the Cat's Eye bandits stole. You must take them to Captain Bezique.

name: Stolen Tomes
description: A rare tome the Cat's Eye bandits stole. You must take it to Captain Bezique.

name: Stolen Ring
description: An expensive necklace that the Cat's Eye bandits have stolen. You must take it back to Captain Bezique.

name: Stolen Necklace
description: An expensive necklace the Cat's Eye bandits stole. You must take it to Captain Bezique.

name: Bezique's Recommendation
description: Take this medallion to the Grand Masters of the Fighter Guild to change your occupation to a Rogue.

name: 1st Letter of Order
description: A certificate of forbidden book collection given by Priest Zigaunt. Carry this around and collect all the forbidden books.

name: 2nd Letter of Order
description: A certificate that proves that you represent the religious body. This certificate is given by Priest Zigaunt. Take this to Lionel for covenant.

name: Lionel's Book
description: The last book of Lioniel. Hand this book to Grand Magister Gallint in the Einhovant School of Magic.

name: Book of Vivyan
description: A forbidden book Simplon sold to Vivyan. Collect five forbidden books and take them to Priest Zigaunt.

name: Book of Simplon
description: The rest of Simplon's forbidden books. Collect 5 forbidden books and take them to Priest Zigaunt.

name: Book of Praga
description: A forbidden book Simplon sold to Praga. Collect 5 forbidden books and take them to Priest Zigaunt.

name: Certificate of Gallint
description: A certificate that Gallint gives for safekeeping of forbidden books. Give to Lionel and receive covenant.

name: Pendant of Mother
description: The pendant of his mother that Guard Praga lost in the ruins. Take this to Guard Praga and receive a forbidden book.

name: Necklace of Mother
description: A necklace chain where a pendant used to hang. Recover the pendant from the zombies in the Ruins of Agony to make it complete.

name: Lionel's Covenant
description: Lionel's pledge not to use the forbidden book again. Give it to Priest Zigaunt and receive the mark of faith.

name: Mark of Faith
description: Take this token to the high priest of the temple to change your occupation to a Cleric.

name: Sorius's Letter
description: A letter received from Master Sorius to be given to Blacksmith Kluto in the Village of Gludin.

name: Kluto Box
description: A box that Kluto asked to give to Master Sorius.

name: Elven Knight Brooch
description: Take this brooch to the Grand Master of the Fighter Guild and he will change your occupation to a Knight.

name: Topaz Piece
description: A piece of topaz obtained from the undead in the ruins. Collect 20 to take to Master Sorius.

name: Emerald Piece
description: A piece of emerald obtained from the Ol Mahum Novices. Collect 20 of these to take to Blacksmith Kluto.

name: Reisa's Letter
description: Master Reisa's letter to Guard Moretti. Find Guard Moretti and give him the letter.

name: Prias's 1st Torn Letter
description: A torn piece of letter written by Prias and is not legible. Collect all four torn pieces and take them to Guard Moretti.

name: Prias's 2nd Torn Letter
description: A torn piece of letter written by Prias and is not legible Collect all four torn pieces and take them to Guard Moretti.

name: Prias's 3rd Torn Letter
description: A torn piece of letter written by Prias and is not legible. Collect all four torn pieces and take them to Guard Moretti.

name: Prias's 4th Torn Letter
description: A torn piece of letter written by Prias and is not legible. Collect all four torn pieces and take them to Guard Moretti.

name: Moretti's Herb
description: An herb that Guard Moretti asked to give to Prias.

name: Moretti's Letter
description: An urgent letter from Guard Moretti to Prias.

name: Prias's Letter
description: A reply of Prias to the letter from Guard Moretti. Hand this to Moretti.

name: Honorary Guard
description: A letter written by Guard Moretti to Master Reisa. Take it to Master Reisa.

name: Reisa's Recommendation
description: Take this recommendation to the Grand Master of the Fighter Guild to change your occupation to an Elven Scout.

name: Rosella's Letter
description: A letter from Rosella to Elven Magister Greenis. Related to ruby, the symbol of fire.

name: Red Down
description: Material needed to make ruby of magical powers. Collect 5 and take them to Magister Greenis for the magical power ruby.

name: Magical Powers Ruby
description: Ruby that symbolizes fire. Gather 4 jewels that symbolize nature and take them to Rosella for a token to change occupations.

name: Pure Aquamarine
description: Aquamarine that symbolizes water. Gather the 4 jewels that symbolize nature and take them to Rosella for a token to change occupations.

name: Appetizing Apple
description: A very ripe apple. Give it to Thalia for information on the aquamarine of water.

name: Gold Leaves
description: Leaves used as fertilizer for the Mother Tree. Collect five leaves and give them to Thalia for an aquamarine.

name: Immortal Love
description: A book Northwind wanted to borrow. If you give this book to Northwind, you can obtain information on the amethyst.

name: Amethyst
description: An amethyst obtained by killing sukar wererat. Give two to Northwind for nobility amethyst.

name: Nobility Amethyst
description: Amethyst that symbolizes wind. Gather 4 jewels that symbolize nature and take them to Rosella for a token to change occupations.

name: Rosella's Recommendation
description: Rosella's recommendation. If you show this to Varsak, you can get information on the fertility peridot.

name: Peridot
description: A peridot you can get if you kill a sniper skeleton. If you collect 3 and show them to Varsak, you can get the fertility peridot.

name: Fertility Peridot
description: A peridot that symbolizes the earth. Gather 4 jewels that symbolize nature and take them to Rosella for a token to change occupations.

name: Eternity Diamond
description: Take this token to the Grand Master of the Magician Guild to change your occupation to an Elven Wizard.

name: Crystal Medallion
description: A necklace given by Priest Manuel. Take this and go to the port Gludin to find the girl who works miracles.

name: Swindler's Money
description: Money from Perrin's swindling. Give it to Allana.

name: Allana's Diary
description: A diary with records of fraud miracle. Show this to Priest Manuel as proof.

name: Lizard Captain Order
description: An order of lizard captain to kidnap the sacred flame of prophecy.

name: Leaf of Oracle
description: Take this to the high priest to change your occupation to an Oracle.

name: Half of Diary
description: Half of the diary given by Allana. You must get money from Perrin and find the other half of the diary.

name: Palus Talisman
description: A talisman inscribed with palus runes that symbolize a deep lake. Carry this and hunt lycanthrope in the Neutral Zone.

name: Lycanthrope Skull
description: A skull obtained after killing lycanthrope. Collect thirteen and take them to Master Virgil.

name: Virgil's Letter
description: A letter written by Master Virgil. Take this to Abyssal Celebrant Kalinta of the village of Gludin.

name: Morte Talisman
description: A talisman with inscription of rune of Morte, symbol of death. Carry this and find materials needed for coffin.

name: Predator's Carapace
description: The hard carapace of a poison spider. Take this and five arachnid tracker silk threads to Abyssal Celebrant Kalinta.

name: Arachnid Tracker Silk
description: Arachnid tracker web threads. Take five of these and a giant poison spider carapace to Abyssal Celebrant Kalinta.

name: Coffin of Eternal Rest
description: A coffin used in funeral of Dark Elven Knight. Take this to Master Virgil.

name: Gaze of Abyss
description: Take this token to the Grand Master of the Fighter Guild to change your occupation to a Knight.

name: Shilen's Call
description: A letter received from Triskel. Go to Witch Arkenia of the Altar of Rites.

name: Arkenia's Letter
description: A letter received from Arkenia. Take this to Guard Leikan to obtain information about the thief.

name: Leikan's Note
description: A simple contract given by Guard Leikan. Must hunt moonstone beasts and collect their molars.

name: Moonstone Beast's Molar
description: A molar obtained after killing a moonstone beast. Collect 10 of these to take to Guard Leikan.

name: Leikan's Knife
description: A knife received as present from Leikan. They say it works well against the Calpicos.

name: Shilen's Tears
description: Magic liquid stolen from the Altar of Rites. Give this to Witch Arkenia.

name: Arkenia's Recommendation
description: A token of thanks received from Arkenia. Take this to Triskel.

name: Iron Heart
description: Take this to the Grand Master of the Dark Elf Guild to change your occupation to an Assassin.

name: Seed of Anger
description: A seed obtained from Charkeren, who is full of anger. Take this to Witch Varika.

name: Seed of Despair
description: A seed obtained from Witch Varika. You must obtain all four seeds to earn the Jewel of Darkness.

name: Seed of Horror
description: A seed obtained from Annika, who is full of horror. Take this to Witch Varika.

name: Seed of Lunacy
description: A seed obtained from a lunatic. Take this to Witch Varika.

name: Family's Remains
description: Remains of Charkeren's slain family. Find 3 and return to Charkeren.

name: Varika's Liquor
description: A medicine Varika made for the son of Duchess Dwell. If you give it to Duchess, you can obtain the Seed of Despair.

name: Knee Bone
description: The knee bone of undead that Annika was looking for. Give this to Annika to obtain the Seed of Horror.

name: Heart of Lunacy
description: The hearts of those who have been turned into skeletons by a sorcerer of lunacy. Collect 3 Hearts of Lunacy and take them to Arkenia.

name: Jewel of Darkness
description: Take this token to the Grand Master of the Dark Elf guild to change your occupation to a Dark Wizard.

name: Sidra's Letter
description: The letter of introduction written by Magister Sidra. Take this to Magister Talbot.

name: Blank Sheet
description: A blank scroll. Take this and hunt dark succubus to obtain bloody runes.

name: Bloody Rune
description: Runes written with the blood of dark succubus. Collect 5 and take to Magister Talbot.

name: Garmiel Book
description: The sacred book of Gran Kain, god of darkness, written in elven language. One of two books Sidra told you to find.

name: Prayer of Adonius
description: The widely beloved prayer book. Take this to Priest Adonius in the village of Gludin.

name: Penitent's Mark
description: The mark that shows one is in the course of repenting one's sins. Carry this and hunt skeletons and zombies in the Ruins of Despair.

name: Ashen Bones
description: Bones from the skeletons and zombies in the Ruins of Despair. Gather 10 and take them to Priest Adonius.

name: Andariel Book
description: The sacred book of Einhasad, goddess of light, written in the Elven language. One of two books Sidra told you to find.

name: Orb of Abyss
description: Take this token to a Grand Master of a Dark Elf Guild in any major city to change your occupation to a Shillien Oracle.

name: Mark of Esquire
description: A mark that indicates an esquire. Wander around the villages in Gludio and meet with guard captains and high priests.

name: Charm of Grain
description: Greenis's good luck charm. Kill pincer spiders and give 5 red down to Greenis.

name: Sap of the Mother Tree
description: Sap of Mother Tree that dryad elders like. Find 5 gold leaves and give them to Thalia.

name: Lucky Potpourri
description: Northwind's lucky potpourri. Give Northwind 2 amethysts obtained from killing sukar wererats.

name: Tamil's Necklace
description: Tamil's necklace. Show it to Perrin.

name: Kluto's Memo
description: A memo from Blacksmith Kluto asking to defeat the Ol Mahum Novices.

name: Lucky Key
description: A bronze key. Hunt zombies in the swamp area, collect 3 remains, and take them to Charkeren.

name: Candle
description: A candle that lights up the dark. Collect 2 knee bones from the undead and give them to Annika for the Seed of Horror.

name: Hub Scent
description: Fragrant herb potpourri. Obtain 3 Hearts of Lunacy from a skeleton scout and take them to Arkenia.

name: Map of Luster
description: A map given by the Flame Salamander. Kill ratman fighters and give the key of flame to the salamander in exchange for the token of fire.

name: Key of Flame
description: The key that can be obtained by killing a ratman fighter. When you give it to a salamander, he will give you the token of fire.

name: Flame Earring
description: The token of fire given by fire spirit salamander. Collect four tokens and give them to Parina to receive the token that enables changing occupations.

name: Broken Bronze Mirror
description: The mirror given by the Wind Sylph. Go to the lizardmen of the Wastelands and obtain the Wind Feather and return it to the Wind Sylph.

name: Wind Feather
description: The feather hidden by the Wind Sylph near the Wastelands. Return this to the Wind Sylph to receive a Wind Token.

name: Wind Bangle
description: The Wind Token given to you by the Wind Spirit Sylph. Collect all four tokens and give them to Parina to receive a special token that will enable you to change occupations.

name: Rama's Diary
description: Kill water seer and take two sparkle pebbles to water Undine for the token of water.

name: Sparkle Pebble
description: Kill water seer in Lake Fellmere for stones. If you give this to Water Undine, she will give you the token of water.

name: Water Necklace
description: The token of water given by water spirit Undine. Collect four tokens and give them to Parina to receive the token that enables changing occupations.

name: Rust Gold Coin
description: The coin given by earth snake. Kill red bear and give red soil to earth snake for Token of Earth.

name: Red Soil
description: The soil obtained from killing red bear. Give to the earth snake for the token of earth.

name: Earth Ring
description: Token of Earth given by earth snake. Collect 4 tokens and give them to Parina to receive the token that enables changing occupations.

name: Bead of Season
description: Take this bead to the high priest of the temple to change your occupation to a Wizard.

name: Rusted Key
description: The key that unlocks Prias's shackles. Take this and go to Prias.

name: Spellbook: Defense Aura
description: Spellbook needed to learn Defense Aura. Used by Elven Fighters and Dark Fighters.

name: Predator's Fang
description: Collect 100 predator's fangs and take them to Pixy Murika.

name: Goblin Club
description: A sturdy club made from thick tree branches and carried by goblins. Take this to Treant Bremac.

name: Glass Shard
description: A broken glass piece. Can be sold in any shop for a low price.

name: Emerald
description: Can be sold in any shop for a high price.

name: Blue Onyx
description: A blue jewel. Can be sold in any shop.

name: Onyx
description: A black jewel. Can be sold in any shop.

name: Silvery Leaf
description: The leaf of a silvery mistletoe. Can be sold in any shop.

name: Bone Arrow
description: An arrow made from a piece of sharpened bone. It is used as an arrow for a D-Grade bow.

name: Fine Steel Arrow
description: A powerful arrow made of steel. It is used as an arrow for a C-Grade bow.

name: Silver Arrow
description: A steel arrow plated with silver.

name: Mithril Arrow
description: A steel arrow plated with mithril.

name: Shining Arrow
description: The most powerful arrow. Unknown material.

name: Golem's Stoneheart
description: A stone found within the remains of a destroyed golem. Take this to Trader Rorento.

name: Monster Eye Carcass
description: The carcass of monster eye. Take this to Trader Sarien.

name: Basilisk's Gizzard
description: The digestive organ of a basilisk. Take this to Trader Sarien.

name: Anatomy Diagram
description: A diagram designed by Avella physicians for human anatomy. Use this to perform Samed's request.

name: Zombie Head
description: A head of zombie from ruins. Take this to Samed of the town of Gludio.

name: Zombie Heart
description: A heart of zombie from ruins. Take this to Samed in the Town of Gludio.

name: Zombie Liver
description: A liver of zombie from ruins. Take this to Samed in the town of Gludio.

name: Skull
description: A skull of skeleton from ruins. Take this to Samed in the town of Gludio.

name: Rib Bone
description: A rib of skeleton from ruins. Take this to Samed in the town of Gludio.

name: Spine
description: A spine of skeleton from ruins. Take this to Samed in the town of Gludio.

name: Arm Bone
description: An arm bone of skeleton from ruins. Take this to Samed in the town of Gludio.

name: Thigh Bone
description: A thigh bone of skeleton from ruins. Take this to Samed in the town of Gludio.

name: Complete Skeleton
description: A complete skeleton put together with bone pieces by undertaker Varsak. Take this to Samed in the town of Gludio.

name: Red Cross Badge
description: A soldier badge of foreign troops. Take this to Leopold in Gludin.

name: Blue Cross Badge
description: A badge of high ranking of Gracian foreign troops. Take this to Leopold in Gludin.

name: Black Cross Badge
description: A badge of captain ranking of Gracian foreign troops. Take this to Leopold in Gludin.

name: Spider's Carapace
description: The hard carapace of a spider. Often used to coat a shield or a helmet. Take this to Trader Arodin.

name: Spider Silk
description: Tough, stretchy spider web. Used to make bowstrings. Take this to Trader Arodin.

name: Spider Venom Sac
description: A sac with a spider's deadly poison in it. Can be sold to Trader Cullinas in Gludin.

name: Broken Stoneheart
description: A small pieces of stone found within the remains of a destroyed golem. Take this to Trader Rorento.

name: Monster Eye's Lens
description: The transparent part of monster eye. Take this to Trader Sarien.

name: Wolf Claw
description: Collect 50 wolf claws and take them to Trader Payne of the weapons and armor shop.

name: Imp Shackles
description: The metal shackles attached around the neck of the imp race. Take this to Sentry Kristin.

name: Black Lion Mark
description: The mark that indicates one is a member of the Black Lion troop.

name: Spellbook: Aqua Swirl
description: Spellbook needed to learn Aqua Swirl. Used by Elven Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Twister
description: Spellbook needed to learn Twister. Used by Dark Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Blaze
description: Spellbook needed to learn Blaze. Used by Human Wizards.

name: Magic Gem
description: An ingredient needed for certain magic.

name: Greater Haste Potion
description: A magical potion that increases movement speed dramatically

name: Greater Swift Attack Potion
description: A magical potion that increases attack speed dramatically

name: Spellbook: Poison Recovery
description: Spellbook needed to learn Poison Recovery. Used by Elven Knights and Elven Scouts.

name: Spellbook: Divine Heal
description: Spellbook needed to learn Divine Heal. Used by Human Knights.

name: Spellbook: Cure Bleeding
description: Spellbook needed to learn Cure Bleeding. Used by Elven Scouts and Elven Knights.

name: Spellbook: Entangle
description: Spellbook needed to learn Entangle. Used by Elven Knights and Elven Scouts.

name: Spellbook: Freezing Strike
description: Spellbook needed to learn Freezing Strike. Used by Palus Knights and Assassins.

name: Spellbook: Power Break
description: Spellbook needed to learn Power Break. Used by Palus Knights and Assassins.

name: Spellbook: Poison
description: Spellbook needed to learn Poison. Used by Palus Knights and Assassins.

name: Spellbook: Sprint
description: Spellbook needed to learn Sprint. Used by Elven Knights and Elven Scouts.

name: Spellbook: Recharge
description: Spellbook needed to learn Recharge. Used by Elven Oracles and Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Disrupt Undead
description: Spellbook needed to learn Disrupt Undead. Used by Clerics, Elven Oracles and Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Resist Poison
description: Spellbook needed to learn Resist Poison. Used by Prophets and Elven Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Mental Shield
description: Spellbook needed to learn Mental Shield. Used by Clerics, Elven Oracles and Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Holy Weapon
description: Spellbook needed to learn Holy Weapon. Used by Clerics and Elven Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Regeneration
description: Spellbook needed to learn Regeneration. Used by Clerics and Elven Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Empower
description: Spellbook needed to learn Empower. Used by Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Berserker Spirit
description: Spellbook needed to learn Berserker Spirit. Used by Clerics.

name: Spellbook: Quickness
description: Spellbook needed to learn Quickness.

name: Spellbook: Sleep
description: Spellbook needed to learn Sleep. Used by Human Wizards, Clerics, Elven Wizards, Elven Oracles, Dark Wizards, and Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Surrender to Water
description: Spellbook needed to learn Surrender to Water.

name: Spellbook: Surrender to Wind
description: Spellbook needed to learn Surrender to Water

name: Spellbook: Peace
description: Spellbook needed to learn Peace. Used by Clerics.

name: Spellbook: Focus
description: Spellbook needed to learn Focus. Used by Clerics and Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Concentration
description: Spellbook needed to learn Concentration. Used by Human Wizards, Clerics, Elven Wizards, Elven Oracles, Dark Wizards, and Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Surrender To Fire
description: Spellbook needed to learn Surrenders To Fire. Used by Human Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Acumen
description: Spellbook needed to learn Acumen. Used by Clerics.

name: Spellbook: Agility
description: Spellbook needed to learn Agility. Used by Elven Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Summon Kat the Cat
description: Spellbook needed to learn Summon Kat the Cat. Used by Human Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Servitor Recharge
description: Spellbook needed to learn Servitor Recharge. Used by Human Wizards, Elven Wizards, and Dark Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Servitor Heal
description: Spellbook needed to learn Servitor Heal. Used by Human Wizards, Elven Wizards, and Dark Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Servitor Wind Walk
description: Spellbook needed to learn Servitor Wind Walk. Used by Human Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Servitor Magic Boost
description: Spellbook needed to learn Bright Servitor. Used by Elven Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Mighty Servitor
description: Spellbook needed to learn Mighty Servitor. Used by Dark Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Slow
description: Spellbook needed to learn Slow. Used by Human Wizards and Dark Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Poisonous Cloud
description: Spellbook needed to learn Poisonous Cloud. Used by Human Wizards and Dark Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Aura Burn
description: Spellbook needed to learn Aura Burn. Used by Human Wizards, Elven Wizards and Dark Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Resist Aqua
description: Spellbook needed to learn Resist Aqua. Used by Prophets and Elven Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Resist Wind
description: Spellbook needed to learn Resist Wind. Used by Prophets and Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Resist Fire
description: Spellbook needed to learn Resist Fire. Used by Clerics.

name: Spellbook: Dryad Root
description: Spellbook needed to learn Dryad Root. Used by Clerics, Elven Oracles and Shillien Oracles.

name: Spellbook: Curse of Chaos
description: Spellbook needed to learn Curse of Chaos. Used by Human Wizards and Dark Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Surrender To Earth
description: Spellbook needed to learn Surrender To Earth. Used by Elven Wizards.

name: Spellbook: Surrender To Poison
description: Spellbook needed to learn Surrender To Poison. Used by Dark Wizards.

name: Blood Mark
description: An item needed to upgrade a clan to level three.

name: Ingredient List
description: A list of cooking ingredients from Jonas. Mandragora essence. Honey. Dionian potato. Marsh moss. Floating eye meat.

name: Sonia's Botany Book
description: A picture that shows what a mandragora looks like. You need this to get mandragora roots.

name: Red Mandragora Root
description: Red mandragora root. Collect these to take them to Trader Sonia.

name: White Mandragora Root
description: Rare white mandragora root. Collect these to take them to Trader Sonia.

name: Red Mandragora Sap
description: Red mandragora sap. One of the five ingredients needed for Jonas's cooking.

name: White Mandragora Sap
description: Transparent mandragora sap. One of the ingredients needed for Jonas's cooking.

name: Jacob's Insect Book
description: A diagram that depicts the drawing of a bee. You must possess this in order to obtain nectar and royal jelly from the bloody bee or the stinger wasp.

name: Nectar
description: Honey water taken from a giant bee. Collect 20 of these to take them to Guard Jaycub.

name: Royal Jelly
description: A rare ingredient that can be taken only from newborn working bees. Collect these and take them to Guard Jaycub.

name: Honey
description: Honey made from the nectar you collected from bees. One of the five ingredients needed for Jonas's cooking.

name: Golden Honey
description: Golden honey made from the nectar and the royal jelly you collected from bees. One of the five ingredients needed for Jonas's cooking.

name: Pano's Contract
description: A contract Grocer Pano gave you. It says, if you kill Hobgoblins and bring 30 pieces of proof, he will give you potatoes as a reward.

name: Hobgoblin Amulet
description: An amulet made of a feather that Hobgoblins carry on their bodies. Collect 30 of these and take them to Grocer Pano.

name: Dionian Potato
description: The highest-quality potatoes grown in the rich soil of southern Dion. One of the five ingredients needed for Jonas's cooking.

name: Glyvka's Botany Book
description: A picture that explains how to collect moss. You need this to collect marsh moss from grey ants or crimson ants.

name: Green Marsh Moss
description: Green marsh moss is sometimes used in cooking. Collect this and take it to Priestess Glyvka.

name: Brown Marsh Moss
description: Rare brown marsh moss, its flavors are superior to the green ones. Collect this and take it to Priestess Glyvka.

name: Green Moss Bundle
description: A bundle of well-cared-for moss, collected from a marshy place for cooking. One of the five ingredients needed for Jonas's cooking.

name: Brown Moss Bundle
description: A bundle of well-cared-for moss, collected from a marshy place for cooking. One of the five ingredients needed for Jonas's cooking.

name: Rollant's Creature Book
description: A picture that shows what a monster eye looks like. You need this to collect the right monster eye searcher or the monster eye gazer.

name: Body of Monster Eye
description: Severed flesh of the dead body of monster eye. Take this to Magister Rollant.

name: Meat of Monster Eye
description: The dead body of a monster eye, ready to cook. One of the five ingredients needed for Jonas's cooking.

name: Jonas's 1st Steak Dish
description: A plate that contains Jonas's monster eye steak. Take this to Magister Mirien.

name: Jonas's 2nd Steak Dish
description: A plate that contains Jonas's monster eye steak. Take this to Magister Mirien.

name: Jonas's 3rd Steak Dish
description: A plate that contains Jonas's monster eye steak. Take this to Magister Mirien.

name: Jonas's 4th Steak Dish
description: A plate that contains Jonas's monster eye steak. Take this to Magister Mirien.

name: Jonas's 5th Steak Dish
description: A plate that contains Jonas's monster eye steak. Take this to Magister Mirien.

name: Mirien's Review
description: A letter from Magister Mirien about the taste of Jonas's dish. Take this to Jonas.

name: Mirien's Review

name: Spiritshot: No Grade
description: The power of a higher-level spirit is bestowed upon a weapon causing its magic power to momentarily increase. Used with a no grade weapon.

name: Spiritshot: D-grade
description: The power of a higher-level spirit is bestowed upon a weapon causing its magic power to momentarily increase. Used with a D-grade weapon.

name: Spiritshot: C-grade
description: The power of a higher-level spirit is bestowed upon a weapon causing its magic power to momentarily increase. Used with a C-grade weapon.

name: Spiritshot: B-grade
description: The power of a higher-level spirit is bestowed upon a weapon causing its magic power to momentarily increase. Used with a B-grade weapon.

name: Spiritshot: A-grade
description: The power of a higher-level spirit is bestowed upon a weapon causing its magic power to momentarily increase. Used with an A-grade weapon.

name: Spiritshot: S-grade
description: The power of a higher-level spirit is bestowed upon a weapon causing its magic power to momentarily increase. Used with an S-grade weapon.

name: Food For Wolves
description: When the hunger gauge of a wolf reaches 55% or below, its food will be consumed automatically.

name: Mark of Challenger
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Trial of the Challenger. An item for occupational change.

name: Letter of Kash
description: Kash's introduction letter. Take this letter to Martien in Giran Castle Town.

name: Watcher's 1st Eye
description: An item obtained from the monster, Gorr. Take this to Martien in Giran Castle Town.

name: Watcher's 2nd Eye
description: An item obtained from the monster, Baraham. Show this to Raldo and...

name: Scroll of Shyslassys
description: An ancient scroll obtained by slaying Shyslassys. Take this to Kash in the Town of Dion.

name: Broken Key
description: A key obtained by slaying Shyslassys. This key is needed in order to open the Chest of Shyslassys.

name: Mark of Duty
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Trial of Duty. An item for occupational change.

name: Letter of Dustin
description: A letter given by Dustin. Deliver the letter to Grand Master Hannavalt in Giran Castle Town.

name: Knights Tear
description: Obtained from the spirit of Sir Herod. Take this to Sir Aaron Tanford.

name: Mirror of Orpic
description: This is needed in order to speak with the ghost of Sir Talianus. Use this to defeat the hangman tree.

name: Tear of Confession
description: Obtained from the ghost of Sir Talianus. Take this to Sir Kiel Nighthawk.

name: Report Piece
description: You may obtain this by hunting strains and ghouls. Gather 10 pieces and put them together to create Talianus's report.

name: Report Piece
description: The completed report. After speaking with Sir Kiel Nighthawk, deliver the report to the ghost of Sir Talianus.

name: Tear of Loyalty
description: This item can be obtained from Isael Silvershadow. Take it to Priest Dustin.

name: Militas Article
description: You can receive this item when you catch a Leto lizardman. Collect 20 of them and take them to Isael Silvershadow.

name: Saints Ashes Urn
description: An object received from Priest Dustin. Deliver this to Sir Windawood.

name: Athebaldt's Skull
description: You can obtain this item from a Breka orc overlord. Take it to Priest Dustin along with Athebaldt's ribs and Athebaldt's shin.

name: Athebaldt's Ribs
description: You can obtain this item from a Breka orc overlord. Take it to Priest Dustin along with Athebaldt's skull and Athebaldt's shin.

name: Athebaldt's Shin
description: You can obtain this item from a Breka orc overlord. Take it to Priest Dustin along with Athebaldt's ribs and Athebaldt's skull.

name: Letter of Windawood
description: A letter received from Sir Colin Windawood. Show this to Priest Dustin.

name: Dufners Letter
description: A letter sent from Master Dufner to Master Terry in the Town of Dion.

name: Terry's 1st Order
description: Investigate the neer ghoul berserkers of the Execution Grounds.

name: Terry's 2nd Order
description: Investigate the ol mahum captain, Turek orc warlord, ant captain and Turak bugbear warrior.

name: Terry's Letter
description: A letter sent by Master Terry to Trader Viktor of Hunters Village.

name: Viktor's Letter
description: A letter sent by Trader Viktor to Master Terry in the Town of Dion. The letter has Terry's seal.

name: Hawkeye's Letter
description: A letter sent by Hawkeye to Trader Viktor of the Hunters Village.

name: Mysterious Runestone
description: A mysterious runestone obtained after slaying neer ghoul berserkers. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Ol Mahum Runestone
description: A mysterious runestone obtained after slaying the ol mahum captain. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Turek Runestone
description: A mysterious runestone obtained after slaying the Turek orc overlord. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Ant Runestone
description: A mysterious runestone obtained after slaying the ant captain. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Turak Bugbear Runestone
description: A mysterious runestone obtained after slaying the Turak bugbear warrior. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Terry's Box
description: A chest containing the mysterious runestones. Take this to Trader Viktor of the Hunters Village.

name: Viktor's Request
description: A request issued by Trader Viktor. "Please gather 10 medusa scales."

name: Medusa Scales
description: The scales of the medusa. Gather 10 of these and take them to Trader Viktor.

name: Shilen's Runestone
description: Strange runestones obtained from the bodies of mutant species. They seem to be related to Shilen, the goddess of death.

name: Analysis Request
description: A request letter sent to Magister Marina of the Ivory Tower from Trader Viktor. The letter asks Marina to analyze the dark bezoar.

name: Marina's Letter
description: A letter sent by Magister Marina to Blacksmith Brunon of the Dwarven Village.

name: Experiment Tools
description: Experimental tools crafted by Blacksmith Brunon. Deliver these to Magister Marina of the Ivory Tower.

name: Analysis Result
description: A document where Magister Marina has organized the analyzed results of the Dark Bezoar. Deliver this to Master Terry in the Town of Dion.

name: Terry's 3rd Order
description: Master Terry's orders. The orders give instructions to come back for the next task after reaching level 36.

name: List of Host
description: A list of the bezoar hosts."Marsh stakato drone, Breka orc overlord, ant warrior captain, Leto lizardman warrior"

name: Abyss Runestone
description: The dark bezoar retrieved from the body of a marsh stakato drone. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Abyss Runestone
description: The runestone retrieved from the body of the Breka orc overlord. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Abyss Runestone
description: The runestone retrieved from the body of the ant captain. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Abyss Runestone
description: The runestone retrieved from the body of the Leto lizardman warrior. Take this to Master Terry.

name: Terry's Report
description: A report detailing information about the runestone incident. Take this to Master Dufner of Giran Castle Town.

name: Mark of Seeker
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Trial of the Seeker. An occupation change related item.

name: Mark of Scholar
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Trial of the Scholar. An occupation change related item.

name: Mirien's 1st Sigil
description: A mark given by Magister Mirien while giving orders to complete High Priest Sylvain's request.

name: Mirien's 2nd Sigil
description: A mark given by Magister Mirien while giving orders to complete Grand Magister Jurek's request.

name: Mirien's 3rd Sigil
description: A mark given by Magister Mirien when giving orders to complete Elder Cronos's request.

name: Mirien's Instruction
description: A note that contains Magister Mirien's instructions. The note gives instructions to come back for the next task after reaching level 36.

name: Maria's 1st Letter
description: A letter sent by Maria to Captain Lucas in the Town of Dion.

name: Maria's 2nd Letter
description: A letter sent by Maria to Astrologer Creta of the village of Floran.

name: Lucas's Letter
description: A letter sent by Captain Lucas in the Town of Dion to Maria.

name: Lucilla's Handbag
description: The handbag left by Maria's friend Lucillas on the night of the theft. Take this to Astrologer Creta.

name: Creta's 1st Letter
description: A letter sent by the Astrologer Creta to Maria in the Town of Dion.

name: Creta's Painting1
description: A painting by Astrologer Creta. It contains a shadow presumed to be that of the thief. Take this to Maria.

name: Creta's Painting2
description: A painting by Astrologer Creta. It contains a shadow presumed to be that of the thief. Take this to Captain Lucas.

name: Creta's Painting3
description: A painting painted by Astrologer Creta. The shadow in the painting is that of a Leto lizardman warrior.

name: Brown Scroll Scrap
description: A scrap of a scroll that contains directions on how to create the crystal of purity. Gather 5 of these and take them to Maria.

name: Crystal of Purity
description: A crystal used to purify the earth. Take this to High Priest Sylvain in the Town of Dion.

name: High Priest's Sigil
description: A mark received from High Priest Sylvain. A proof given to those who are carrying out the orders of the High Priest.

name: Grand Magister's Sigil
description: A mark received from Grand Magister Jurek. A proof given to those who are carrying out the orders of the Grand Magister.

name: Crono's Sigil
description: A mark received from Elder Cronos. This signifies proof that someone is carrying out orders from Elder Cronos.

name: Sylvain's Letter
description: High Priest Sylvain's letter. Take this to Maria in the Town of Dion.

name: Symbol of Sylvain
description: A symbol given to those who have passed High Priest Sylvain's test. Take this to Magister Mirien in the Town of Dion.

name: Jurek's List
description: The list of evil creatures that Grand Magister Jurek asked you to investigate: Monster eye destroyer, Breka orc shaman, and shackle.

name: Monster Eye Destroyer Skin
description: A beamer's skin. Gather 5 of these and take them to Grand Magister Jurek of Giran Castle Town.

name: Shaman's Necklace
description: A Breka orc shaman's necklace. Gather 5 of these and take them to Grand Magister Jurek in Giran Castle Town.

name: Shackle's Scalp
description: Skin of the shackle's head. Gather 2 of these and take them to Grand Magister Jurek of Giran Castle Town.

name: Symbol of Jurek
description: A symbol given to those who have passed Grand Magister Jurek's test. Take this to Magister Mirien in the Town of Dion.

name: Cronos Letter
description: A letter sent by Elder Cronos to Magister Dieter in the Town of Giran.

name: Dieter's Key
description: A key to the chest where Dieter has hidden the Scriptures of Knowledge. Take this to Astrologer Creta in Floran Village.

name: Creta's 2nd Letter
description: Creta's letter describing the theft of the Scriptures of Knowledge. Take this to Magister Dieter in the Town of Giran.

name: Dieter's Letter
description: A letter from Magister Dieter to Trader Edroc of the weapons shop of Hunters Village.

name: Dieter's Diary
description: Magister Dieter's Diary, given by him in hopes that it may be of aid in recovering the Scriptures of Knowledge.

name: Raut's Letter Envelope
description: A plain letter envelope with no contents. The envelope is addressed "To Warehouse Keeper Raut".

name: Triff's Ring
description: A ring given by Drunkard Triff. Show this ring to those whom Triff has entrusted with the Scriptures of Knowledge.

name: Scripture Chapter 1
description: The 1st book of the Scriptures of Knowledge. Gather all 4 books.

name: Scripture Chapter 2
description: The 2nd book of the Scriptures of Knowledge. Gather all 4 books.

name: Scripture Chapter 3
description: The 3rd book of the Scriptures of Knowledge. Gather all 4 books.

name: Scripture Chapter 4
description: The 4th book of the Scriptures of Knowledge. Gather all 4 books.

name: Valkon's Request
description: Warehouse Keeper Valkon's request. The instructions are to bring back the crystal of purity.

name: Poitan's Notes
description: Blacksmith Poitan's accounting books. Take this to Elder Casian of the Wastelands.

name: Scriptures of Knowledge
description: A scripture edited by Elder Cronos. It is said to contain a vast knowledge of the past. It is part of a 4-scripture set.

name: Strong Liquor
description: As its name indicates, a strong liquor. Take this to Drunkard Triff at the harbor.

name: Crystal of Purity
description: An item that Warehouse Keeper Valkon in Giran Castle Town agreed to trade with you for scripture chapter 2.

name: Casian's List
description: 10 ghoul's skins, 12 units of medusa's blood, 5 units of fettered soul's ichor, and 5 enchanted gargoyle's nails.

name: Ghoul's Skin
description: The skin of a ghoul. Gather 10 of these and take them to Elder Casian.

name: Medusa's Blood
description: Medusa's Blood. Gather 12 bottles and take them to Elder Casian.

name: Fettered Soul's Ichor
description: The ichor of a fettered soul. Gather 5 units and take them to Elder Casian.

name: Enchanted Gargoyle's Nail
description: The enchanted nails of a gargoyle. Gather 5 of these and take them to Elder Casian.

name: Symbol of Cronos
description: The mark of Cronos, the top sage of the continent. Take this to Magister Mirien in the Town of Dion.

name: Mark of Pilgrim
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Trial of the Pilgrim. An occupation change related item.

name: Book of Sage
description: A book received from Elder Casian. Take this book to Hermit Santiago.

name: Voucher of Trial
description: A mark given by Hermit Santiago. Show this to Seer Tanapi of the Orc Village.

name: Spirit of Flame
description: Proof that you have an understanding of the spirit of flame. In order to carry out the next stage of this trial, go see Gauri Twinklerock of Dwarven Village.

name: Essence of Flame
description: A jewel obtained from the lava salamander. Take this to the Ancestor Martankus.

name: Book of Gerald
description: A book given by Priest Gerald. The book looks very cheap.

name: Gray Badge
description: A badge given by Wanderer Dorf. Take this to Priest Primos at Giran Castle Town.

name: Picture of Nahir
description: A picture of the monster, Nahir. Defeat Nahir, who lurks in the depths of the Elven Ruins on Talking Island.

name: Hair of Nahir
description: The hair of the monster, Nahir. Take this to Priest Petron.

name: Statue of Einhasad
description: A statue of Einhasad given by Priest Petron. Take this to Andellia, who lives near the Mother Tree Glade in the Elven Village.

name: Book of Darkness
description: A book given by Uruha. The book contains unrecognizable letters written in blood.

name: Debris of Willow
description: Debris obtained from the black willow. Go and seek Uruha while in possession of this.

name: Tag of Rumor
description: This contains rumors regarding Wanderer Dorf and Priest Gerald.

name: Mark of Trust
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Testimony of Trust. An occupation change related item.

name: Letter to Elf
description: A letter requesting the trust of the Elves. Deliver this to Hierarch Asterios of the Elven Village.

name: Letter to Darkelf
description: A letter requesting the trust of the Dark Elves. Deliver this to Tetrarch Thifiell of the Dark Elf Village.

name: Letter to Dwarf
description: A letter requesting the trust of the Dwarves. Deliver this to Lockirin of the Dwarven Village.

name: Letter to Orc
description: A letter requesting the trust of the Orcs. Deliver this to the Pa'agrio Lord Kakai at the Orc Village.

name: Letter to Seresin
description: A letter given by High Priest Hollint. Deliver this to Cardinal Seresin at the Town of Oren.

name: Scroll of Dark Elf Trust
description: A scroll given by Tetrarch Thifiell. Deliver this, along with the scroll of the Elf trust, to High Priest Hollint.

name: Scroll of Elf Trust
description: This item can be obtained from Hierarch Asterios. Give this item along with scroll of Dark Elf trust to High Priest Hollint.

name: Scroll of Dwarf Trust
description: A scroll given by Lockrin of the Iron Gate. Deliver this, along with the scroll of Orc trust, to Cardinal Seresin.

name: Scroll of Orc Trust
description: A scroll given by Kakai, Lord of Flame. Deliver this, along with the scroll of Dwarf trust, to Cardinal Seresin.

name: Recommendation of Hollint
description: Deliver this to High Priest Biotin at the Temple of Einhasad on Talking Island.

name: Order of Asterios
description: Slay Luell of Zephyr Winds and Actea of Verdant Wilds and bring back proof of their deaths.

name: Breath of Winds
description: Obtained from Luell of Zephyr Winds. Deliver this, along with the seed of verdure to Hierarch Asterios.

name: Seed of Verdure
description: A proof obtained from Actea of Verdant Wilds. Deliver this, along with the breath of winds, to Hierarch Asterios.

name: Letter from Thifiell
description: Deliver this to Magister Clayton, member of the Dark Elf Guild, in the Town of Dion.

name: Blood of Guardian Basilisk
description: This item can be obtained from a guardian basilisk. Collect 10 of them and create basilisk Plasma.

name: Giant Aphid
description: This may be obtained from various soldier ants. Gather 10 to create the honey dew.

name: Stakatos Fluids
description: This may be obtained from various marsh stakatos. Gather 10 to create stakato ichor.

name: Basilisk Plasma
description: Take this, along with the honey dew and stakato ichor, to Magister Clayton.

name: Honey Dew
description: Take this, along with the basilisk plasma and stakato ichor, to Magister Clayton.

name: Stakato Ichor
description: Take this, along with the honey dew and basilisk plasma, to Magister Clayton.

name: Order of Clayton
description: Obtain basilisk plasma of a guardian basilisk, stakato ichor of a marsh stakato and honey dew of an ant guard and take them to Magister Clayton.

name: Parasite of Lota
description: This may be obtained from the windsus. Gather 10 of these and take them to Seer Manakia.

name: Letter to Manakia
description: A letter received from Pa'agrio Lord Kakai. Deliver this to Seer Manakia in the Town of Giran.

name: Letter of Manakia
description: A letter received from Seer Manakia. Deliver this to Pa'agrio Lord Kakai.

name: Letter to Nikola
description: A letter received from Lockrin of the Iron Gate. Deliver this to Maestro Nikola of the Cruma Tower.

name: Order of Nikola
description: Obtain 10 porta heartstones and take them to Maestro Nikola.

name: Heartstone of Porta
description: This may be obtained from a porta. Gather 10 of these and take them to Maestro Nikola.

name: Mark of Duelist
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Trial of the Duelist. An item for occupational change.

name: Order Gludio
description: Kill at least 10 punchers and 10 noble ant leaders in Gludio.

name: Order Dion
description: Kill at least 10 marsh stakato drones and 10 dead seekers in Dion.

name: Order Giran
description: Kill at least 10 Breka orc overlords and 10 fettered souls in Giran.

name: Order Oren
description: Kill at least 10 Leto lizardman overlords and 10 enchanted monster eyes in Oren.

name: Order Aden
description: Kill at least 10 Tamlin orcs and 10 Tamlin orc archers in Aden.

name: Puncher's Shard
description: A shard of the broken puncher. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Noble Ant's Feeler
description: The feelers of the noble ant leader. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Drone's Chitin
description: The chitin of the marsh stakato drone. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Dead Seeker Fang
description: The fangs of the dead seeker bat. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Overlord Necklace
description: Collect ten Breka orc overlord's necklaces and take them to Duelist Kaien.

name: Fettered Soul's Chain
description: The chains that surround a fettered soul's body. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Chief's Amulet
description: The amulet of a Leto lizardman overlord. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Enchanted Eye Meat
description: The flesh of an enchanted eye. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Tamrin Orc's Ring
description: The ring of a Tamrin orc. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Tamrin Orc's Arrow
description: The arrows of a Tamrin orc archer. Collect 10 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Final Order
description: Defeat the Excuro and Krator of the Cruma Tower, the Grandis of Giran, the Timak Orc Overlord of Oren, and the Lakin of Aden 3 times.

name: Excuro's Skin
description: The skin of the excuro. Collect 3 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Krator's Shard
description: The shard of a broken krator. Collect 3 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Grandi's Skin
description: The skin of a grandis. Collect 3 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Timak Orc's Belt
description: The belt of a Timak orc overlord. Collect 3 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Lakin's Mace
description: Mace used by a lakin. Collect 3 of these to take to Duelist Kaien.

name: Luther's Letter
description: A letter given by Master Luther. Take this to Alex of the village of Floran.

name: Alex's Warrant
description: A warrant written by Alex. Take this to Leirynn.

name: Leirynn's 1st Order
description: A list of orders given by Leirynn. "Slay 10 Delu Shamans and bring back their tokens."

name: Delu Totem
description: The totem of Shaman Saska. Take this, along with the rest of the Delu Shaman totems, to Leirynn.

name: Leirynn's 2nd Order
description: A list of orders given by Leirynn. Slay Delu chief Kalkis and bring back proof.

name: Chief Kalki's Fang
description: Proof that the Delu chief Kalkis has been slain. Take this to Leirynn.

name: Leirynn's Report
description: A report issued by Leirynn. Take this to Alex.

name: Strange Map
description: A strange map obtained from the Delu chief Kalkis.

name: Lambert's Map
description: A map where the name of Lambert, the former lord's guard, is written.

name: Alex's Letter
description: A letter given by Alex. Take this and go to drunkard Borys at the Town of Gludio.

name: Alex's Order
description: Alex's orders. The orders give instructions to find and recover Duke Ashton's missing gold.

name: Wine Catalog
description: A list of premium wine published by the Giran Traders' Guild. Show this to Trader Tyra.

name: Tyra's Contract
description: The contract that Trader Tyra has drawn up. The contract states that Tyra will trade 10 pouches of red spore dust for a Malrukian wine.

name: Red Spore Dust
description: Red spore dust obtained by slaying the giant fungus. Gather 10 pouches and bring them to Trader Tyra.

name: Malrukian Wine
description: Premium wine crafted following the methods of the Malruk tribe. Take this to drunkard Borys.

name: Old Order
description: An old order received from drunkard Borys. Take this and go to bodyguard Jax.

name: Jax's Diary
description: A diary that bodyguard Jax has given, saying that it will aid in the search for Solt's and Makel's maps.

name: 1st Torn Map Piece
description: A piece of the map that belonged to the former lord's guard Solt. Gather 4 of these.

name: 2nd Torn Map Piece
description: A piece of the map that belonged to the former lord's guard Makel. Gather 4 of these.

name: Solt's Map
description: A map where the name of the former lord's guard Solt is written.

name: Makel's Map
description: A map where the name of the former lord's guard Makel is written.

name: Combined Map

description: A letter introducing Priestess Pupina. Take this and meet with to Preacher Sla of the Wastelands.

name: Sla's Letter
description: A letter given by Sla. Take this to Katari, who is near the waterfalls of the Neutral Zone.

name: Greetings
description: A letter sent by Sla to her disciples. Go to the Orc Village, Dwarven Village, and Talking Island in this order.

name: Ol Mahum's Money
description: Ol Mahum currency given by the themselves as a reward. For what...? Nobody knows.

name: Katari's Letter
description: Katari's reply letter to Sla. Collect 3 reply letters from Sla's disciples and deliver them to Sla.

name: Nyakuri's Letter
description: Nyakuri's reply letter to Sla. Collect 3 reply letters from Sla's disciples and deliver them to Sla.

name: Undead List

name: Ramus's Letter

name: Ripped Diary

name: Letter of Betrayer

name: Bone Fragment

name: Bone Fragment

name: Bone Fragment

name: Enchanted Iron Golem Scrap

name: Arkenia's Instructions

name: Stardust

name: Isael's Letter

name: Grail of Purity
description: A grail crafted of pure mithril. Catch the tears of the unicorn with the grail and take it back to Thalia.

name: Tears of Unicorn
description: The tears shed by Eva's unicorn when it is killed with Talin's spear. Take this back to Thalia.

name: Water of Life
description: The holy water that contains the powers of life to rejuvenate the Mother Tree. Take this and go to Hierarch Asterios.

name: Pure Mithril Ore
description: The ore of pure mithril. Gather 10 of these, along with the rest of the ingredients, and take them back to Blacksmith Pushkin.

name: Ant Soldier Acid

name: Wyrm's Talon

name: Harpy's Down
description: The down feathers obtained after slaying a harpy. Gather 20 of these and take them back to Priest Adonius.

name: Talin's Spear Blade
description: The blade portion of Talin's spear. Take this, along with the remaining portions of the spear, back to Isael Silvershadow.

name: Talin's Spear Shaft
description: The shaft portion of Talin's spear. Take this, along with the remaining portions of the spear, back to Isael Silvershadow.

name: Kasandra's Remains
description: The remains of Kasandra, Metheus's sister. Take this back to Brother Metheus.

description: 10 units each of medusa's blood, marsh spider fluids, dead seeker's dung, tyrant's blood and nightshade root.

name: Medusa's Ichor
description: The bottled blood of a medusa. Collect 10 of these and take them back to Master Ixia

name: Marsh Spider Fluids
description: The bottled fluids of a marsh spider. Collect 10 of these and take them back to Master Ixia.

name: Dead Seeker Dung
description: The dung of dead seeker bats. Collect 10 of these and take them back to Master Ixia.

name: Tyrant's Blood
description: The bottled blood of tyrant. Collect 10 of these and take them back to Master Ixia.

name: Nightshade Root
description: The roots of the rare nightshade herb. Collect 10 of these and take them back to Master Ixia.

name: Belladonna
description: A legendary poison that can kill a bull with a single drop. Take this to Brother Metheus.

name: Alder's Skull
description: The skull of Alders, who drafted the copy of Kaysha's Revelations. Take this to Magister Kaira.

name: Alders Skull
description: Skull of Priest Alders. Take it to Magister Roa, a distant descendant of the priest.

name: Alder's Receipt
description: The receipt for the item that Alder entrusted to the warehouse. Take this and go to the warehouse in the Village of Gludin.

name: Revelations Manuscript
description: A copy of Kaysha's Revelations. Take this to Magister Kaira.

name: Kaira's Instructions

name: Black Willow Leaf

name: Blight Treant Sap
description: The sap of a blight treant. Take this to Arkenia.

name: Timak Orc Head

name: Glove of Burai

name: Manakia's 2nd Letter
