description: Prefect Kasman's letter. Take this and go to the Vuku Orc Chief.

name: Kasman's 2nd Letter
description: Prefect Kasman's letter. Take this and go to the Turek Orc Chief.

name: Kasman's 3rd Letter
description: Prefect Kasman's letter. Take this and go to the Lennunt Orc Chief.

name: Driko's Contract
description: Vuku Chief Driko's contract. The contract contains instructions to hunt the marsh stakato drones in the Cruma Marshlands.

name: Stakato Drone Husk
description: The husks of a marsh stakato drone. Collect 30 of these and take them to Vuku Chief Driko.

name: Tanapi's Order
description: Seer Tanapi's orders. Hunt the Lennunt Orc Chief and seers and recover the dcepter of Tantos.

name: Scepter of Tantos
description: The flame scepter of the now-perished Tantos tribe. Take this to Seer Tanapi.

name: Ritual Box
description: A box containing the scepters recovered from the Orcs of the Tantos tribe. Take this to Pa'agrio Lord Kakai.

name: Mark of Prosperity
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Testimony of Prosperity. An occupation change related item.

name: 1st Ring of Testimony
description: A ring given to those Dwarves attempting the Testimony of Prosperity. Find the 4 proofs of prosperity.

name: 2nd Ring of Testimony
description: A ring given to those Dwarves attempting the Testimony of Prosperity. Find Maphr's tablet, which contains the ultimate secrets of geometry.

name: Old Account Book
description: Iron Gate Lockirin's account book. The proof of wealth. Take this to Warehouse Keeper Parman of Giran Castle Town.

name: Blessed Seed
description: A seed containing the blessings of Maphr. The proof of fertile lands. Take this to Warehouse Keeper Parman of Giran Castle Town.

name: Emily's Recipe
description: A recipe good for childbirth and childbirth recovery. The proof of fertility. Take this to Warehouse Keeper Parman of Giran Castle Town.

name: Lilith's Elven Wafer
description: Food regarded as the secret to the Elves' longevity. The proof of health. Take this to Warehouse Keeper Parman of Giran Castle Town.

name: Maphr Tablet Fragment
description: A fragment of Maphr's tablet, which contains the ultimate secrets of geometry. Take this to Warehouse Keeper Parman of Giran Castle Town.

name: Collection License
description: A license that allows the bearer to collect guild contributions. Seek out those who still owe contributions and collect the funds from them.

name: Lockirin's 1st Notice
description: A notice that guild contributions are due. Take this to Golden Wheel's Spiron.

name: Lockirin's 2nd Notice
description: A notice that guild contributions are due. Take this to Silver Scale's Balanki.

name: Lockirin's 3rd Notice
description: A notice that guild contributions are due. Take this to Bronze Key's Keef.

name: Lockirin's 4th Notice
description: A notice that guild contributions are due. Take this to Filaur of the Gray Pillar.

name: Lockirin's 5th Notice
description: A notice that guild contributions are due. Take this to Black Anvil's Arin.

name: Contribution of Shari
description: Trader Shari's guild contribution. Take this to Golden Wheel's Spiron.

name: Contribution of Mion
description: Trader Mion's guild contribution. Take this to Silver Scale's Balanki.

name: Contribution of Maryse
description: Maryse Redbonnet's guild contribution. Take this to Silver Scale's Balanki.

name: Maryse's Request
description: The note containing Maryse Redbonnet's request. The instructions are to bring back 100 animal skins. Animal skins are a manufacturing ingredient item.

name: Contribution of Toma
description: Master Toma's guild contribution. Take this to Black Anvil's Arin.

name: Receipt of Bolter
description: Miner Bolter's contribution receipt. Take this to Black Anvil's Arin to confirm if Miner Bolter has already submitted his contribution.

name: 1st Receipt of Contribution
description: The contribution receipt received from Golden Wheel's Spiron. Collect 5 receipts and take them to Lockrin of the Iron Gate.

name: 2nd Receipt of Contribution
description: The contribution receipt received from Silver Scale's Balanki. Collect 5 receipts and take them to Lockrin of the Iron Gate.

name: 3rd Receipt of Contribution
description: The contribution receipt received from Bronze Key's Keef. Collect 5 receipts and take them to Lockrin of the Iron Gate.

name: 4th Receipt of Contribution
description: A contribution receipt received from Filaur of the Gray Pillar. Collect 5 receipts and take them to Lockrin of the Iron Gate.

name: 5th Receipt of Contribution
description: The contribution receipt received from Black Anvil's Arin. Collect 5 receipts and take them to Lockrin of the Iron Gate.

name: Procuration of Torocco
description: The bearer of this procuration hereby agrees to make contributions on behalf of Torocco. Take this to Bronze Key's Keef.

name: Bright's List
description: A list of ingredients that Guard Bright has written. "20 mandragora petals, 10 bunches of crimson moss"

name: Mandragora Petal
description: The petals of a mandragora flower. Collect 20 of these and take them to Guard Bright.

name: Crimson Moss
description: Crimson Moss obtained from giant red ants. Collect 10 of these and take them to Guard Bright.

name: Mandragora Bouquet
description: A flower bouquet made of mandragora petals and crimson moss. Take this to Emily in the Town of Dion.

name: Parman's Instructions
description: A note containing Warehouse Keeper Parman's instructions. The instructions are to come back after reaching level 38.

name: Parman's Letter
description: Warehouse Keeper Parman's letter. Take this to Maestro Nikola of the Cruma Tower.

name: Clay Dough
description: A piece of clay that Maestro Nikola has given. Use this to make a copy of the keyhole from the titan's box.

name: Pattern of Keyhole
description: The keyhole pattern made from clay dough. Take this to Maestro Nikola.

name: Nikolas' List
description: 20 stakato shells, 10 toad lord sacs, 10 spider thorns and 10 D-grade crystals.

name: Stakato Shell
description: The shell of a marsh stakato. A key ingredient in making the titan's key.

name: Toad Lord Sac
description: The poison sac removed from the neck of a toad lord. A key ingredient in making the titan's key.

name: Spider Thorn
description: A thorn removed from the shell of a swamp spider. A key ingredient in making the titan's key.

name: Mark of Champion
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Test of the Champion. An item for occupational change.

name: Ascalon's 1st Letter
description: Veteran Ascalon's letter. Take this to Mason in the Town of Dion.

name: Mason's Letter
description: A letter from Mason to Veteran Ascalon of Giran Castle Town.

name: Iron Rose Ring
description: A ring given by Mason. The ring is engraved with the symbol of the iron rose. Complete the revenge in place of Mason.

name: Ascalon's 2nd Letter
description: Veteran Ascalon's letter. Take this to Trader Groot of Giran Castle Town.

name: White Rose Insignia
description: An insignia given by Trader Groot. It was formerly worn by the medics of the iron rose. Aid Trader Groot in his material gathering.

name: Groot's Letter
description: A letter from Trader Groot to Veteran Ascalon in Giran Castle Town.

name: Ascalon's 3rd Letter
description: Veteran Ascalon's letter. Take this to Captain Mouen of the Town of Oren.

name: Mouen's 1st Order
description: Cut off and bring back the heads of 100 road scavengers or road collectors.

name: Mouen's 2nd Order
description: Destroy the Leto lizardmen and bring back 100 of their fangs.

name: Mouen's Letter
description: A letter from Captain Mouen to Veteran Ascalon of Giran Castle Town.

name: Harpy's Egg
description: An egg obtained after slaying a harpy. Collect 30 of these and take them to Trader Groot of Giran Castle Town.

name: Medusa's Venom
description: The venom obtained after slaying a medusa. Collect 30 of these and take them to Trader Groot of Giran Castle Town.

name: Windsus Bile
description: The bile obtained after slaying a windsus. Collect 30 of these and take them to Trader Groot of Giran Castle Town.

name: Bloody Axe Head
description: The head of a Bloody Axe Elite. Collect 100 of these and return to Mason in the Town of Dion.

name: Road Ratman Head
description: The severed head of a road scavenger or road collector. Collect 100 of them and take them to Captain Mouen.

name: Leto Lizardman Fang
description: The fangs of a slain Leto lizardman. Collect 100 of these and take them to Captain Mouen.

name: Mark of Sagittarius
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Test of the Sagittarius. An occupation change related item.

name: Bernard's Introduction
description: Take this letter and go to Sagittarius Hamil of the Village of Floran.

name: Hamil's 1st Letter
description: Take this letter and meet with Sir Aron Tanford of the Southern Wastelands.

name: Hamil's 2nd Letter
description: Take this letter and go to Prefect Vokian of Giran Castle Town.

name: Hamil's 3rd Letter
description: Take this letter and go to Gauen of the Ivory Tower.

name: Hunter's 1st Rune
description: A stone engraved with a hunter's rune. Collect 10 of these and take them to Hamil of the Village of Floran.

name: Hunter's 2nd Rune
description: A rune obtained from Breka orc overlords or Shamans. Collect 10 of these and take them, along with the snake talisman, to Prefect Vokian.

name: Talisman of Kadesh
description: A strange talisman obtained after slaying Kadesh. Take this to Sagittarius Hamil of the Village of Floran.

name: Talisman of Snake
description: Talisman that is related to a serpent totem spirit worshipped by Breka orcs. Take it to Prefect Vokian of Giran Castle Town.

name: Mithril Clip
description: A key ingredient in restoring the Crescent Bow. Take this, along with the rest of the ingredients, to Magister Gauen of the Ivory Tower.

name: Stakato Chitin
description: A key ingredient in restoring the Crescent Bow. Take this, along with the rest of the ingredients, to Magister Gauen of the Ivory Tower.

name: Reinforced Bowstring
description: A key ingredient in restoring the Crescent Bow. Take this, along with the rest of the ingredients, to Magister Gauen of the Ivory Tower.

name: Manashen's Horn
description: A key ingredient in restoring the Crescent Bow. Take this, along with the rest of the ingredients, to Magister Gauen of the Ivory Tower.

name: Blood of Lizardman
description: The blood shed by Leto Lizardmen. Kadesh appears when enough of this is gathered.

name: Mark of Witchcraft
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Test of Witchcraft. An occupation change related item.

name: Orim's Diagram
description: A diagram of relics, given by Orim of the Shadow. The 6 jewels needed for opening the Cube of Aklantoth are depicted here.

name: Alexandria's Book
description: A book that contains records on who purchased Aklantoth's Gems. "Magister Iker, Magister Kaira, Trader Lara"

name: Iker's List
description: Collect and bring back 20 dire wyrm fangs, 20 Leto lizardman charms, and 20 enchanted stone golem heartstones.

name: Dire Wyrm Fang
description: The fangs of a slain Dire Wyrm. Collect 20 of these and take them to Magister Iker.

name: Leto Lizardman Charm
description: A totem obtained after slaying the Leto Lizardman. Collect 20 of these and take them to Magister Iker.

name: Enchanted Golem Heartstone
description: A crystal found amongst the shattered fragments of an enchanted stone golem. Collect 20 of these and take them to Magister Iker.

name: Lara's Memo
description: Trader Lara's sales records. It is recorded that a man named Ismel bought the jewel from Lara.

name: Nestle's Memo
description: Trader Lara's purchase records. It is recorded that Leopold of the Black Lion brought the jewel.

name: Leopold's Journal
description: A portion of Leopold's Diary. It is recorded that 3 deserters died and became undead while escaping to the Wastelands.

name: Aklantoth 1st Gem
description: Gem that can be obtained from Magister Iker. Find all 6 of Aklantoth gems and take them to Orim the Shadow.

name: Aklantoth 2nd Gem
description: The gem given by Magister Kaira. Find all 6 of Aklantoth gems and take them to Orim the Shadow.

name: Aklantoth 3rd Gem
description: The gem that can be obtained by killing a nameless revenant. Find all 6 of Aklantoth gems and take them to Orim the Shadow.

name: Aklantoth 4th Gem
description: The gem that can be obtained by slaying a skeletal mercenary. Find all 6 of Aklantoth gems and take them to Orim the Shadow.

name: Aklantoth 5th Gem
description: The gem that can be obtained by slaying a skeletal mercenary. Find all 6 of Aklantoth gems and take them to Orim the Shadow.

name: Aklantoth 6th Gem
description: The gem that can be obtained by slaying a skeletal mercenary. Find all 6 of Aklantoth gems and take them to Orim the Shadow.

name: 1st Brimstone
description: A mark left behind by the Drevanul Prince Zeruel when escaping from his binds.

name: Orim's Instructions
description: A set of instructions written by Orim of the Shadow. The instructions are to bring back the Sword of Binding and Soul Trap Crystal.

name: Orim's 1st Letter
description: A letter from Orim of the Shadow to Sir Karol Vasper of the Town of Gludin. The letter asks for the loan of the Sword of the Seal.

name: Orim's 2nd Letter
description: A letter from Orim of the Shadows to Magister Iker of Giran Castle Town. The letter asks for the loan of the Soul-trap Crystal.

name: Sir Vasper's Letter
description: A letter from Sir Klaus Vasper to Vadin of the Town of Oren. The letter gives permission for the use of the Sword of Binding.

name: Vadin's Crucifix
description: A holy crucifix of the order, given by Vadin. Take this and go hunt Tamlin Orcs.

name: Tamlin Orc Amulet
description: Amulets that the Tamlin Orcs carry for sorcery purposes. Gather 20 of these and take them to Vadin.

name: Vadin's Sanctions
description: A sanctions letter from Vadin allowing for the use of the Sword of Binding. Take this to Sir Klaus Vasper of the Town of Gludin.

name: Iker's Amulet
description: An amulet given by Magister Iker. It is said to have powers of protection against evil...

name: Soultrap Crystal
description: A crystal with the power to trap and seal the soul of a monster. Use this to seal the spirit of the Drevanul Zeruel.

name: Purgatory Key
description: A key needed to close Aklantoth's Chest. Take this to Orim of the Shadow.

name: Zeruel Bind Crystal
description: A crystal that contains the trapped soul of the Drevanul Zeruel. Take this to Orim of the Shadow.

name: 2nd Brimstone
description: A mark left behind by the Drevanul Prince Zeruel while escaping from the body of Fisher Evert.

name: Mark of Summoner
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Test of the Summoner. An occupation change related item.

name: Leto Lizardman Amulet
description: An amulet obtained after slaying a Leto Lizardman. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Sac of Redspores
description: Red spores obtained from the bodies of the giant fungus. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Karul Bugbear Totem
description: A totem obtained after slaying the Karul Bugbear. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Shards of Manashen
description: A shard of the shattered Manashen. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Breka Orc Totem
description: A totem that can be obtained after slaying a Breka orc. Collect 30 of them and take them to Trader Lara.

name: Crimson Bloodstone
description: A spirit stone embedded in the body of a fettered soul. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Talons of Tyrant
description: The talon of a slain tyrant. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Wings of Droneant
description: Wings obtained after slaying Noble Ants at the Ant's Nest. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Tusk of Windsus
description: The tusks of a slain windsus. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Fangs of Wyrm
description: The fangs of a slain wyrm. Gather 30 of these and take them back to Trader Lara.

name: Lara's 1st List
description: "Collect 30 Leto lizardman amulets from the Plains of the Lizardmen and 30 units of red spore dust from the giant fungus in the Sea of Spores."

name: Lara's 2nd List
description: "Collect 30 Karul bugbear totems from Hunters Valley and 30 shards of manashen from the Crater of the Ivory Tower."

name: Lara's 3rd List
description: "Collect 30 Breka orc totems from Breka's Stronghold and 30 crimson bloodstones of fettered soul from Death Pass."

name: Lara's 4th List
description: "Collect 30 Tyrant Talons from the Wastelands and 30 Windsus Tusks from Death Pass."

name: Lara's 5th List
description: "Collect 30 noble ant wings from the Ant Nest and 30 wyrm fangs from Gorgon's Flower Garden."

name: Galatea's Letter
description: A letter from Head Summoner Galatea to Trader Lara in the Town of Dion.

name: Beginner's Arcana
description: An Arcana card used by apprentice Summoners. You must have this in order to participate in Summoner battles.

name: Almors's Arcana
description: Summoner Almors's Arcana. The proof of victory from a battle. Take this to Head Summoner Galatea.

name: Camoniell's Arcana
description: Summoner Camoniell's. The proof of victory from a battle. Take this to Head Summoner Galatea.

name: Belthus's Arcana
description: Summoner Belthus's Arcana. The proof of victory from a battle. Take this to Head Summoner Galatea.

name: Basillia's Arcana
description: Summoner Basillia's Arcana. The proof of victory from a battle. Take this to Head Summoner Galatea.

name: Celestiel's Arcana
description: Summoner Celestiel's Arcana. The proof of victory from a battle. Take this to Head Summoner Galatea.

name: Brynthea's Arcana
description: Summoner Brynthea's Arcana. The proof of victory from a battle. Take this to Head Summoner Galatea.

name: 1st Crystal of Starting
description: An indication that a Summoner battle has begun.

name: 1st Crystal of Inprogress
description: An indication that a Summoner battle is in progress.

name: 1st Crystal of Foul
description: An indication that foul play was involved in a Summoner battle. Take this to Summoner Almors.

name: 1st Crystal of Defeat
description: An indication that the Summoner has been defeated in battle. Take this to Summoner Almors.

name: 1st Crystal of Victory
description: An indication that the Summoner has been victorious in a battle. Take this to Summoner Almors.

name: 2nd Crystal of Starting
description: An indication that a Summoner battle has begun.

name: 2nd Crystal of Inprogress
description: An indication that a Summoner battle is in progress.

name: 2nd Crystal of Foul
description: An indication that foul play was involved in a Summoner battle. Take this to Summoner Camoniell.

name: 2nd Crystal of Defeat
description: An indication that the Summoner has been defeated in a battle. Take this to Summoner Camoniell.

name: 2nd Crystal of Victory
description: An indication that the Summoner has been victorious in a battle. Take this to Summoner Camoniell.

name: 3rd Crystal of Starting
description: An indication that a Summoner battle has begun.

name: 3rd Crystal of Inprogress
description: An indication that a Summoner battle is in progress.

name: 3rd Crystal of Foul
description: An indication that foul play was involved in a summoner battle. Take this to Summoner Belthus.

name: 3rd Crystal of Defeat
description: An indication that the Summoner has been defeated in a battle. Take this to Summoner Belthus.

name: 3rd Crystal of Victory
description: An indication that the Summoner has been victorious in a battle. Take this to Summoner Belthus.

name: 4th Crystal of Starting
description: An indication that a Summoner battle has begun.

name: 4th Crystal of Inprogress
description: An indication that a Summoner battle is in progress.

name: 4th Crystal of Foul
description: An indication that foul play was involved in a Summoner battle. Take this to Summoner Basillia.

name: 4th Crystal of Defeat
description: An indication that the Summoner has been defeated in a battle. Take this to Summoner Basillia.

name: 4th Crystal of Victory
description: An indication that the Summoner has been victorious in a battle. Take this to Summoner Basillia.

name: 5th Crystal of Starting
description: An indication that a Summoner battle has begun.

name: 5th Crystal of Inprogress
description: An indication that a Summoner battle is in progress.

name: 5th Crystal of Foul
description: An indication that foul play was involved in a Summoner battle. Take this to Summoner Celestiel.

name: 5th Crystal of Defeat
description: An indication that the Summoner has been defeated in a battle. Take this to Summoner Celestiel.

name: 5th Crystal of Victory
description: An indication that the Summoner has been victorious in a battle. Take this to Summoner Celestiel.

name: 6th Crystal of Starting
description: An indication that a Summoner battle has begun.

name: 6th Crystal of Inprogress
description: An indication that a Summoner battle is in progress.

name: 6th Crystal of Foul
description: An indication that foul play was involved in a Summoner battle. Take this to Summoner Brynthea.

name: 6th Crystal of Defeat
description: An indication that the Summoner has been defeated in a Summoner battle. Take this to Summoner Brynthea.

name: 6th Crystal of Victory
description: An indication that the Summoner has been victorious in a Summoner battle. Take this to Summoner Brynthea.

name: Mark of Lord
description: A mark given to those who have passed the Test of the Lord. An item for occupational change.

name: Ordeal Necklace
description: A necklace given to those who are attempting the Test of the Lord. Go seek 5 Chiefs of different tribes and return with their approvals.

name: Varkee's Charm
description: The Atuba chief Varkee's charm. Go back to him after completing this task.

name: Tantus's Charm
description: The Neruga chief Tantus's charm. Go back to him after completing this task.

name: Hatos's Charm
description: The Urutu Chief Hatos's charm. Go back to him after completing this task.

name: Takuna's Charm
description: The Duda-Mara Chief Takuna's charm. Go back to him after completing this task.

name: Chianta's Charm
description: Gandi Chief Chianta's charm. Go back to him after completing this task.

name: Manakia's Orders
description: A document containing Seer Manakia's orders. It tells you to kill Breka orc shamans and Breka orc overlords and bring back 20 Breka orc fangs.

name: Breka Orc Fang
description: A Breka orc's fang. Collect 20 of them and take them to Seer Manakia.

name: Manakia's Amulet
description: A mark received after passing Manakia's test. Take this to Atuba Chief Varkees.

name: Huge Orc Fang
description: The totem of the Atuba tribe. Gather the totems of the 5 tribes and take them to Pa'agrio Lord Kakai.

name: Sumari's Letter
description: A letter from Blacksmith Sumari to Seer Somak in the Town of Dion.

name: Urutu Blade
description: A blade crafted by Blacksmith Sumari. Take this to Urutu Chief Hatos.

name: Timak Orc Skull
description: The skull of a slain Timak Orc. Gather 10 of these and take them to Urutu chief Hatos.

name: Sword Into Skull
description: The totem of the Urutu tribe. Gather the totems of the 5 tribes and take them to Pa'agrio Lord Kakai.

name: Neruga Axe Blade
description: The blade portion of a ceremonial axe. Take this to Neruga Chief Tantus.

name: Axe of Ceremony
description: The totem of the Neruga tribe. Gather the totems of the 5 tribes and take them to Pa'agrio Lord Kakai.

name: Marsh Spider Feeler
description: A key ingredient in making the Duda-Mara tribe totem. Gather 10 of these and take them to Duda-Mara Chief Takuna.

name: Marsh Spider Feet
description: A key ingredient in making the Duda-Mara tribe totem. Gather 10 of these and take them to Duda-Mara Chief Takuna.

name: Handiwork Spider Brooch
description: The totem of the Duda-Mara tribe. Gather the totems of the 5 tribes and take them to Pa'agrio Lord Kakai.

name: Cornea of Enchanted Monster Eye
description: A key ingredient in making the Gandi tribe totem. Gather 20 of these and take them to Gandi Chief Chianta.

name: Monster Eye Woodcarving
description: The totem of the Gandi tribe. Gather the totems of the 5 tribes and take them to Pa'agrio Lord Kakai.

name: Bear Fang Necklace
description: The totem of the Hestui tribe. Take this and go to the Ancestor Martankus in the Cave of Trials.

name: Martankus's Charm
description: The talisman of the Ancestor Martankus. Go back to him after completing this task.

name: Ragna Orc Head
description: The head of a slain Ragna Orc. Take this to the Ancestor Martankus.

name: Ragna Chief Notice
description: "He who destroys the Lord of Flame shall be appointed Chief." Take this to the ancestral spirit Martankus.

name: Immortal Flame
description: The mark received after passing the Ancestor Martankus' test. Take this to Pa'agrio Lord Kakai.

name: Animal Lover's List
description: Go and seek Gatekeeper Bella in the Town of Gludio, Guard Metty in the Town of Dion, and Accessory Jeweler Ellie in the Town of Giran.

name: Animal Slayer's 1st List
description: Destroy the animal slayers of Talking Island: giant spiders, talon spiders, and bladers.

name: Animal Slayer's 2nd List
description: Destroy the animal slayers of the Elven Forest: crimson spiders, hook spiders, and the pincer spiders.

name: Animal Slayer's 3rd List
description: Destroy the animal slayers of the Dark Elven Forest: lesser dark horrors, dark horrors, and prowlers.

name: Animal Slayer's 4th List
description: Destroy the animal slayers of the Indomitable Plateau: kasha spiders, kasha poker spiders, and kasha blade spiders.

name: Animal Slayer's 5th List
description: Destroy the animal slayers of the Spine Mountains Mining Zone: hunter tarantulas and plunder tarantulas.

name: Bloody Fang
description: A fang dripping with animal blood. Collect 50 of these and take them to Martin, the Pet Manager of the Town of Gludin.

name: Bloody Claw
description: A claw dripping with animal blood. Collect 50 of these and take them to Martin, the Pet Manager of the Town of Gludin.

name: Bloody Nail
description: A nail dripping with animal blood. Collect 50 of these and take them to Martin, the Pet Manager of the Town of Gludin.

name: Bloody Kasha Fang
description: A fang of a kasha dripping with animal blood. Collect 50 of these and take them to Martin, the Pet Manager of the Town of Gludin.

name: Bloody Tarantula Nail
description: A nail of a tarantula dripping with animal blood. Collect 50 of these and take them to Martin, the Pet Manager of the Town of Gludin.

name: Crystal Brooch
description: A brooch received from Warehouse Keeper Wilfred. Present this to Lilith of the temple at the Village of Talking Island.

name: Spellbook: Greater Heal
description: Spellbook needed to learn the Greater Heal spell. Used by Bishops, Elven Elders, and Shillien Elders.

name: Spellbook: Greater Battle Heal
description: Amulet required for the Greater Battle Heal spell. Used by Bishops.

name: Spellbook: Greater Group Heal
description: Amulet required for the Greater Group Heal spell. Used by Bishops and Shillien Elders.

name: Spellbook: Remedy
description: Amulet required for the Remedy spell. Used by Paladins.

name: Cargo Box
description: Freight box on which the mark of Aden Commercial Guild is stamped.

name: Cargo Box
description: Freight box on which the mark of Aden Commercial Guild is stamped.

name: Cargo Box
description: Freight box on which the mark of Aden Commercial Guild is stamped.

name: Cargo Box
description: Freight box on which the mark of Aden Commercial Guild is stamped.

name: Gludio Apples
description: Apple cultivated in the Gludio region. Can be sold at shops.

name: Dion Corn Meal
description: Powder made from corn cultivated in Dion. Can be sold at shops.

name: Dire Wolf Pelts
description: Tanned Dire Wolf pelts. Can be sold at shops.

name: Moonstone
description: Jewel of blue and white light called Moonjang Stone or Moonstone. Can be sold at shops.

name: Gludio Wheat Flour
description: Powder made from wheat cultivated in the Gludio region. Can be sold at shops.

name: Spidersilk Rope
description: Strong rope made of weaving tarantula spider silk. Can be sold at shops.

name: Alexandrite
description: Precious jewel that shines green in the sunlight and red in the moonlight. Can be sold at shops.

name: Silver Tea Service
description: High-quality teacup and dish set crafted of silver. Can be sold at shops.

name: Mechanic Golem Spare Parts
description: A component of mechanic golems. Useless for anything else, it is best sold.

name: Fire Emerald
description: Precious jewel that shines with an intense red light. Can be sold at shops.

name: Avellan Silk Frock

description: MP is instantly restored.

name: Dice
description: A simple game of chance! Roll 'em!!

name: Blade Mold
description: Cargo that Trader Arodin needs to send to the Dark Elves. Find all 20 of them and take them to Trader Tyra.

name: Tyra's Bill
description: A note from Trader Tyra. Take it to Trader Arodin in Gludin Village.

name: Ranger's Report - Part 1
description: First piece of a ranger's report. Find all 4 pieces and take them to Guard Alvah.

name: Ranger's Report - Part 2
description: Second piece of a ranger's report. Find all 4 pieces and take them to Guard Alvah.

name: Ranger's Report - Part 3

name: Ranger's Report - Part 4

name: Weapons Trade Contract
description: The contract that was carried by an Ol Mahum General. It is stamped with the Mark of the Dwarves. Take it to Guard Alvah.

name: Attack Directives
description: An operation order that was carried by an Ol Mahum General. Take it to Guard Alvah.

name: Certificate of the Silver Scale Guild
description: Certificate that verifies one's membership to the Silver Scale Guild.

name: Rolento's Cargobox
description: The war supplies that the Dwarven trader Rolento promised to send to Turek orcs. First, show it to Guard Alvah.

name: Ol Mahum Captain's Head
description: A severed head of an ol mahum captain. Collect 30 of them and take them to Turek Chief Burai.

name: Jade Crystal
description: Jade gemstone from the Enchanted Valley. Collect them and take them to Bentley of Hunters Village.

name: Ancient Statue of Goddess
description: A statue of a goddess from an old empire that has been discovered in the cemetery. Take it to Priestess Flownia of Aden Castle Town.

name: GalfRedo Romer's Bust
description: A statue created by the ancient sculptor Berona. Take it to Trader Galibredo of the Town of Oren.

name: Eye of the Shadow
description: Collect 50 eyes of the Shadow and take them to Warehouse Keeper Sorint.

name: Certificate of Participation: Battle Royal
description: The certificate that allows one to participate in a Battle Royal. This game is played by grade 1 members of the Coin Collectors Club.

name: Trade Cargo
description: The cargo boxes that have been robbed from the wagon of the Trade Guild. Collect 30 of them and take them to Guard Weisz.

name: Agnes's Holy Symbol
description: The Crucifix of the goddess of Einhasad. This article was left by Priestess Agnes after her death. Take it along with Agnes's Rosary to Priest Adonius.

name: Agnes's Rosary
description: A rosary used while praying. It was left by Priestess Agnes after her death. Take it along with the Crucifix of the goddess of Einhasad to Priest Adonius.

name: Sinister Totem
description: A black colored totem that exudes an evil aura. Take it to High Priestess Levian.

name: Bear Skin
description: The pelts obtained by hunting bears. Collect 20 of them and take them to Grocer Pano of Floran Village.

name: Enku Orc's Head
description: Beheaded head of an Enku Orc. Collect 100 of them and take them to Orc Lady Jennifer.

name: Orc Heads Bouquet -1
description: A bouquet made by tying 100 orc heads together. On behalf of Jennifer who is shy, deliver it to High Prefect Drikus.

name: Orc Heads Bouquet -2
description: A bouquet made by tying 100 orc heads together. On behalf of Jennifer who is shy, deliver it to Priest Manuel.

name: Orc Heads Bouquet -3
description: A bouquet made by tying 100 orc heads together. On behalf of Jennifer who is shy, deliver it to Vuku Chief Driko.

name: Orc Heads Bouquet -4
description: A bouquet made by tying 100 orc heads together. On behalf of Jennifer who is shy, deliver it to Seer Somak.

name: Orc Heads Bouquet -5
description: A bouquet made by tying 100 orc heads together. On behalf of Jennifer who is shy, deliver it to Prefect Dowki.

name: Orc Heads Bouquet -6
description: A bouquet made by tying 100 orc heads together. On behalf of Jennifer who is shy, deliver it to Warden Endrigo.

name: Orc Heads Bouquet -7
description: A bouquet made by tying 100 orc heads together. On behalf of Jennifer who is shy, deliver it to Captain Lucas.

name: Jennifer's Box
description: The box that a man who is smitten by Orc Lady Jennifer asked this to be delivered to her. What do you think is in the box...?

name: Articles of Dead Heroes
description: The articles of dead soldiers who were sent as an expeditionary force 1,000 years ago. These articles have been collected by hunting cave servants. Take them to Antharas Watchman Gilmore.

name: Old Key
description: An article left by a dead soldier. His descendent Sir Kristof Rodemai is living in Giran Castle Town. Take it to him.

name: Old Hilt
description: An article left by a dead soldier. His descendant Duelist Kaien is living in the Town of Oren. Take it to him.

name: Totem Necklace
description: An article left by a dead soldier. His descendent, High Prefect Garvarentz, is living in Hunters Village. Take it to him.

name: Einhasad Crucifix
description: An article left by a dead soldier. Take it to High Priest Orven of Einhasad Temple in Aden Castle Town where the dead soldier used to be stationed.

name: Victim's Arm Bone
description: The arm bone of a victim who has been eaten by a Crokian. Collect the five types of bones and take them to Xenovia.

name: Victim's Thigh Bone
description: The thigh bone of a victim who has been eaten by a Crokian. Collect the five types of bones and take them to Xenovia.

name: Victim's Skull
description: The skull of a victim who has been eaten alive by a Crokian. Collect the five types of bones and take them to Xenovia.

name: Victim's Rib Bone
description: The rib bone of a victim who has been eaten by a Crokian. Collect the five types of bones and take them to Xenovia.

name: Victim's Spine
description: The spine of a victim who has been eaten by a Crokian. Collect the five types of bones and take them to Xenovia.

name: Jar of Bones
description: An urn that contains the bones of all the victims. Ask Mad Doctor Orpheus to resurrect the victims.

name: Useless Bone Pieces
description: Useless bone pieces obtained after hunting Crokians. If you take them to Orpheus, perhaps something good will happen...?

name: Powder to Summon Dead Souls
description: The magic powder bought from Magister Xenovia. Throw it along with the victims' bones into the Psychic Medium's Urn.

name: Sack of the Dead
description: A sack containing a victim's soul. An urn was possessed by the victim's soul. Take it to Locksmith Dorothy.

name: Frog Prince
description: What are you waiting for? You promised to help me! Release me from this curse immediately! I must regain my appearance as soon as possible!!!

name: Fly Powder
description: Powder made by grinding dried flies. Use it when you fail in your attempt to transform a frog.

name: Calculator
description: The latest model of calculator. Take it to Blacksmith Brunon.

name: Gemstone Beast's Crystal
description: Crystal obtained by slaying a gemstone beast. Collect 10 of these and take them to Blacksmith Silvera.

name: Titan's Powerstone
description: The Titan's Powerstone that has been extracted from the corpse of a Giant. Take it to Magister Hanellin.

name: Hanellin's 1st Letter
description: A letter that Hanellin entrusted you with. Take it to Magister Harne of the Dark Elven Villlage and receive your next assignment from her.

name: Hanellin's 2nd Letter
description: A letter that Hanellin entrusted you with. Take it to Claudia Athebaldt of Aden Castle Town and receive your next assignment from her.

name: Hanellin's 3rd Letter
description: A letter that Hanellin entrusted you with. Take it to Martien of the Giran Castle Town and receive your next assignment from him.

name: 1st Key of Ark
description: The key that was found upon the corpse of the guardian of the sacred ark. Use this key to open the sacred ark and retrieve the sacred object.

name: 2nd Key of Ark
description: The key that was taken after killing Elberos, the guardian of the sacred ark. Use the key to open the sacred ark and retrieve the sacred object.

name: 3rd Key of Ark
description: The key that was taken after killing Shadowfang, the guardian of the sacred ark. Use the key to open the sacred ark and retrieve the sacred object.

name: White Fabric
description: A large piece of white cloth given by Magister Hanellin. Kill the Platinum Tribe Shamans and Overlords and soak the cloth with their blood.

name: Blooded Fabric
description: A piece of cloth soaked in the blood of angels and the Platinum race. Hanellin has told you that in order to challenge Baium, you must wrap this blood-soaked cloth around your body.

name: Order of Gosta
description: The order states that you should hunt Tasaba Lizardmen and Tasaba Lizardman Shaman and bring back their fangs as proof.

name: Lizard Fang
description: The fangs that have been collected as proofs that Tasaba Lizardmen and Tasaba Lizardman Shaman have been hunted.

name: Barrel of League
description: This seems to be the cargo that was stolen from Iason Heine's wagon by Tasaba Lizardmen.

name: Operation Document - 1/10
description: This document was found in the cargo of the Trade Guild. The document contains various information regarding Innadril. How could this have happened...?

description: A book consisting of 10 pages of operation orders bound together. Who should we take it to...?

name: Bill of Iason Heine
description: The bill's face value is 1,000 adena. If you take it to Roman of the Blacksmith Guild in Innadril, you can use it to purchase various ingredients.

name: Gillian's Diary
description: Gillian's diary. The last entry was made one year ago.

name: Gillian's Notes
description: Partial lyrics of a song Gillian was jotting down.

name: Unfinished Music
description: An unfinished music score of a song that Gilian composed for a former lover.

name: Gillian's Heart
description: The heart that Gillian threw out to forget his feelings of love. Return it to the Revenant of Gillian.

name: Gandi Tribe's Relic
description: The sacred object of the Gandi Tribe that has been recovered from Bugbears. Take it to Gandi Chief Chianta in the Town of Dion.

name: Swan's Flute
description: A flute that Troubadour Swan had obtained as a gift for Musician Nanarin.

name: Swan's Letter
description: A love letter that Troubadour Swan wants to send to Musician Nanarin along with the flute. Take them to Musician Nanarin.

name: Event Clothes
description: A gift that Musician Nanarin is sending to Musician Barbado. Take it to Barbado.

name: Nanarin's Flute
description: A gift that Musician Nanarin is sending to Musician Barbado. Take it to Barbado.

name: Sabrin's Black Beer
description: A gift that Musician Nanarin is sending to Musician Barbado. Take it to Barbado.

name: Stolen Black Beer
description: Black beer that was stolen from Jonas. Take it to Trader Sabrin.

name: Stolen Event Clothes
description: Event clothes that were stolen from Trader Sonia. Take them to Guard Xaber.

name: Clothes Chest Key
description: The key given by Bard Swan. Use this key to open the clothes chest and retrieve the event clothes.

name: Beer Chest Key
description: The key given by Bard Swan. Use this key to open the beer chest and get the black beer out of it.

name: Fairy Leaf
description: A leaf given by Fairy Mimyu to put on the fairy's neck wound that was inflicted by a hatchling.

name: Ratman Scavenger's Skull
description: Heads of Ratman Scavengers that you hunted after receiving a request from Katari. Collect 10 of them and take them to Katari.

name: Turek War Hound's Tail
description: The tails of Turek war Hounds that Piotur asks you to catch. Collect 10 of them and take them to Piotur.

name: Tyrant Kingpin's Heart
description: Tyrant Kingpin's Heart. Take it to Elder Casian.

name: Trisalim Tarantula's Venom Sac
description: The venom sacs of Trisalim Tarantulas that Magister Joan asked you to hunt. Collect three and take them to Magister Joan.

name: Penitent's Manacles
description: A heavy set of manacles forged at the Black Judge's behest.  Take them to the Black Judge.

name: Manual of Manacles
description: Blacksmith's Frame x 1, Steel x 5, Adamantite Nugget x 2, Silver Nugget x 10, Cokes x 10

name: Tarlk Amulet
description: A mark that can be obtained by catching a Tarlk Bugbear or a Tarlk Basilisk. Collect 30 and take them to a Clan Hall Herald.

name: Contest Certificate
description: A certificate that one can present to participate in the hunt for Tarlk Basilisks, a preliminary contest for a Clan Hall Siege War.

name: Ant's Ichor
description: Bodily fluids extracted from ants or ant captains. Collect 20 and take them to Elder Casian.

name: Noble Ant's Nerve Tissue
description: The nerve tissue harvested from a Noble Ant's head. Take it to Elder Casian along with the Ant's Ichor.

name: Casian's Enzyme
description: Enzyme created by Elder Casian. Find the Ant Larvae sleeping within the the Ant Nest Dungeon and administer the enzyme to them.

name: Alligator Leather
description: Pelts obtained from alligators caught on Alligator island. You can sell it to Enverun.

name: Blue Back Alligator Leather
description: Leather from Blue Back Alligators caught on Alligator Island. You can sell it to Enberun at a high price.

name: Jewel Studded Alligator Leather
description: A piece of Jewel Studded Alligator Leather caught on Alligator Island. You can sell it to Enberun at a high price.

name: Certificate of Approval to Create a Belt
description: If you take a sufficient amount of Alligator Leather and show it to Gabana, a master leather craftsman, you can have an Alligator Leather Belt made.

name: Certificate of Approval to Create a Purse
description: If you take a sufficient amount of Alligator Leather and show it to Gabana, a master leather craftsman, you can have an Alligator Leather Purse made.

name: Crystal of Water
description: A lump of crystal that contains the energy of water. You should find the Stone Statue of Water and dedicate it to the statue.

name: Crystal of Fire
description: A lump of crystal that contains the energy of fire. You should find the Stone Statue of Fire and dedicate it to the statue.

name: Crystal of Wind
description: A lump of crystal that contains the energy of wind. You should find the Stone Statue of Wind and dedicate it to the statue.

name: Crystal of Earth
description: A lump of crystal that contains the energy of earth. You should find the Stone Statue of Earth and dedicate it to the statue.

name: Crystal of Darkness
description: A lump of crystal that contains the energy of darkness You should find the Stone Statue of Darkness and dedicate it to the statue.

name: Crystal of Light
description: A lump of crystal that contains the energy of light. You should find the Stone Statue of Light and dedicate it to the statue.

name: Jade Crystal
description: Jade crystals that had been gathered from the Enchanted Valley. Collect them and take them to Bentley of Hunters Village.

name: Bust of Ancient Goddess
description: A statue of a goddess that was created by the ancient sculptor Berona in ancient times.

name: The Work of the ancient sculptor Berona
description: A statue created by the ancient sculptor Berona. It has not been evaluated by antique experts yet.

name: Ancient Statue of Goddess - Prototype
description: A statue created by Berona, an ancient sculptor. - Prototype

name: Ancient Statue of Goddess - Original
description: A statue created by Berona, a sculptor in ancient times. - Original

name: Ancient Statue of Goddess - Replica
description: Replicated statues that have been created by present day sculptors who imitated Berona's works.

name: Ancient Statue of Goddess - Forgery
description: Forgeries that have been created in imitation of the ancient sculptor Berona's works.

name: Blue Eva
description: Special Coin

name: Gold Einhasad
description: Special Coin

name: Silver Shilen
description: Special Coin

name: Bloody Pa'agrio
description: Special Coin

name: Barrel of Liquor
description: A barrel that is filled to the brim with delicious and fragrant liquor. The barrel is very heavy.

name: Precious Scarab
description: A scarab that is transparent and shines like a precious stone. Among hustlers it is traded at a high price.

name: Simbelmyne
description: A type of flower that is believed to have the power to heal sickness. It is a favorite of elves.

name: Odd (looking) Doll
description: It is a strange looking statue of a living creature that looks like an imp. It is an orc's favorite item.

name: Scarlet Dress
description: A very attractive scarlet Aden-style dress designed for a virtuous lady.

name: Nebulite Orb
description: It is made by cutting Nebulite into a spherical shape. Take this to Magic Trader Cema in Hardin's Academy.

name: Ectoplasm Liqueur
description: An exotic tasting liqueur made from ectoplasm. Very popular among connoisseurs.

name: Prince's Trophy
description: The winning trophy that Prince Malcom won in a dance competition. You can sell it at a store or keep it as a souvenir.

name: Prince's Autobiography
description: The autobiography of Prince Malcom that bears his hand-written signature. Sell it at a store.

name: Prince's Bust
description: A statue of Prince Malcom made of pure gold. Although quite ugly, it will fetch a handsome price.

name: Silk Handkerchief
description: A beautiful and elaborate handkerchief decorated with a flower pattern and lace. Its design could attract the attention of princes and princesses.

name: Luxurious Goblet
description: A luxuriously designed goblet. It seems to be an object made during the period of the Elmo Aden Empire.

name: Scepter of Darkness
description: A staff that gives off dark magic power. On its handle, the words "Great Demon King" are engraved.

name: Succubus Perfume
description: Perfume used by Succubus noblewomen. A very strong fragrance, not popular among Elves and Humans.

name: Succubus Mirror
description: A mirror used by Succubus noblewomen when they put on cosmetics. It is also said to be used occasionally by blood queens.

name: Heart of Darkness
description: A heart-shaped stone piece that gives off the aura of dark magic power. On its reverse, the words "I love you Merkenis!" are engraved.

name: Royal Orc Totem
description: A totem made by carving out a whole lump of red granite.

name: Pearl Trodden/Trampled By A Wild Hog
description: A walnut sized bead that is smeared with dirt. Perhaps, it is a pearl.

name: Boar's Tusk
description: The tusk of a boar that looks somewhat similar to the ivory of an elephant.

name: Sweet Potato
description: A large sized sweet potato that was just plucked out of the soil. You s it or roast it. It will make a delicious treat.

name: Beast's Claws
description: White lion's sharp claws. It is rumored that it is being traded among collectors at a high price.

name: Beast's Mane
description: A white lion's luxuriant mane. It is rumored to be sold at a high price among collectors.

name: Ginseng Root
description: Rare medicine imported from the Orient.

name: Honey Jar
description: A jar containing sweet honey.

name: Bear's Gall
description: The gall of a bear that is known to be highly effective in promoting one's health and well-being as well as having mysterious healing properties.

name: Fresh Samon
description: A fresh salmon that seems to have been just caught from a river.

name: Sushi Riceball
description: The Schuttgart type sushi rice ball. The delicious seasoning of well minced meat gets absorbed into the rice and produces a wonderful taste.

name: Avellan Spice
description: Exotic spice that has been imported from Avella of the Orient.

name: Lucky Rabbit Weed
description: Rabbit weed that is supposed to bring luck. It is the favorite food of rabbits and elpys.

name: Malcom's Check
description: A check of tremendous face value signed by Prince Malcom. It can be cashed at a warehouse in Giran Castle Town.

name: Deposit Box Key
description: A key for a private deposit box located in a warehouse in Giran Castle Town.

name: Dwarven Royal Seal
description: A royal seal made of carved jade. It is engraved with the seal of the Dwarven royal family.

name: Dwarven Royal Crown
description: A king's crown made of gold. It is engraved with the seal of the Dwarven royal family.

name: Dwarven Dance Manual
description: A dance manual that details ballroom dancing techniques. This book will make you a dancing hero!

name: Calculator
description: Allows one to perform a simple calculation.

name: Hanellin's White Flower
description: A mark of Hannelin. Along with your companions each carrying a red flower and yellow flower respectively, go to Aden Castle Town to see her.

name: Hanellin's Red Flower
description: A mark of Hannelin. Along with your companions each carrying a white flower and yellow flower respectively, go to Aden Castle Town to see her.

name: Hanellin's Yellow Flower
description: A mark of Hannelin. Along with your companions each carrying a white flower and red flower respectively, go to Aden Castle Town to see her.

name: Book of Saint
description: The book of Saint Solina. Take it along with the blood of a Saint and the bough of a Saint to Magister Hanellin.

name: Blood of Saint
description: The blood of Saint Solina, hardened into a dark-colored substance contained in a glass bottle. Take it, along with the Book of Saint and the Bough of Saint to Magister Hanellin.

name: Bough of Saint
description: The Scepter of Saint Solina. It appears to be just a dead dry tree branch. Take it along with the book of a Saint and the blood of a Saint and take it to Magister Hanellin.

name: White Fabric
description: A large piece of white cloth given by Magister Hanellin. Hanellin will tell you its purpose.

name: Green Dimensional Stone
description: Activates a Dimensional Vortex. Allows you to move to the first floor of the Tower of Insolence.

name: Blue Dimensional Stone
description: Activates a Dimensional Vortex. Allows you to move to the fifth floor of the Tower of Insolence.

name: Red Dimensional Stone
description: Activates a Dimensional Vortex. Allows you to move to the 10th floor of the Tower of Insolence.

name: Green Dimensional Stone - Shard
description: A broken shard of the green Dimensional Stone. Collect these and take them to Researcher Kaplan.

name: Blue Dimensional Stone - Shard
description: A broken shard of the blue Dimensional Stone. Collect these and take them to Researcher Euclie.

name: Red Dimensional Stone - Shard
description: A broken shard of the red Dimensional Stone. Collect these and take them to Researcher Pitagon.

name: Bill of Iason Heine
description: Its value is 1000 adena, redeemable by Roman of the Blacksmith Guild in Innadril. You can use it to buy various ingredients.

name: Musical Score - Theme of Love
description: Posthumously released musical score of Gillian. If you take it to Maestro Melody, you can have an echo crystal made.

name: Musical Score - Theme of Battle
description: The musical score for the Battle March of Flames. If you take it to Maestro Melody, you can have an echo crystal made.

name: Musical Score - Theme of Journey
description: A musical score composed by Troubadour Swan. If you take it to Maestro Melody, you can have an echo crystal made.

name: Echo Crystal - Theme of Journey
description: An echo crystal that plays the theme music of a journey. May only be used once.

name: Echo Crystal - Theme of Battle
description: An echo crystal that plays the theme music of a battle.

name: Echo Crystal - Theme of Love
description: An echo crystal that plays the theme music of love. May only be used once.

name: Echo Crystal - Theme of Solitude
description: An echo crystal that plays the theme music of solitude. May only be used once.

name: Echo Crystal - Theme of the Feast
description: An echo crystal that plays the theme music of a feast. May only be used once.

name: Echo Crystal - Theme of Celebration
description: An echo crystal that plays the theme music of a celebration. May only be used once.

name: Echo Crystal - Theme of Comedy
description: An echo crystal that plays the theme music of a comedy. May only be used once.

name: Musical Score - Theme of Celebration
description: A musical score containing the theme music of a celebration. If you take it to Maestro Melody, you can have an echo crystal made.

name: Musical Score - Theme of Comedy
description: A musical score containing the theme music of a comedy. If you take it to Maestro Melody, you can have an echo crystal made.

name: Musical Score - Theme of Solitude
description: A musical score composed by Musician Nanarin. If you take it to Maestro Melody, you can have an echo crystal made.

name: Musical Score - Theme of the Feast
description: A musical score composed by Musician Barbado. If you take it to Maestro Melody, you can have an echo crystal made.

name: Dragon Bugle of Wind
description: A bugle used to play the strider of the Wind.

name: Dragon Bugle of Star
description: A bugle used to play the strider of a Star.

name: Dragon Bugle of Dusk
description: A bugle used to play the strider of the Dusk.

name: Penitent's Manacles
description: The heavy manacles used to summon a Sin Eater. Summoning the Sin Eater consumes all the summoner's Exp. The Sin Eater must be fed Food for Wolves.

name: Manacles of Penitent
description: Having consumed your sins, the Sin Eater has disappeared, leaving you with this ordinary pair of manacles.  To repeat this quest, take them back to the Black Judge.

name: Alligator Leather Belt
description: An Alligator Leather Belt designed and created by Verche, a master leather craftsman.

name: Blue Alligator Leather Belt
description: An Alligator Leather Belt designed and created by Verche, a master leather craftsman. It is made from a rare blue type of Leather.

name: Bejeweled Leather Belt
description: An Alligator Leather Belt designed and created by Verche, a master leather craftsman. It is made from a Leather that is studded with rare jewels.

name: Alligator Leather Purse
description: An Alligator Leather Purse designed and created by Verche, a master leather craftsman.

name: Blue Alligator Leather Purse
description: An Alligator Leather Purse designed and created by Verche, a master leather craftsman. It is made from a rare blue type of Leather.

name: Bejeweled Purse
description: An Alligator Leather Purse designed and created by Verche, a master leather craftsman. It is made of Leather studded with rare jewels.

name: Elemental Stone Powder
description: Elemental stone powder obtained from a stone statue in the Forgotten Temple. Can be sold at any store or taken to Magister Nell.

name: Elemental Stone Shards
description: The shards of elemental stones obtained from stone statues in the Forgotten Temple. Can be sold at any store or taken to Magister Nell.

name: Elemental Stone Lump
description: The lumps of elemental stone obtained from stone statues in the Forgotten Temple. Can be sold at any store or taken to Magister Nell.

name: Bentley's Request
description: A request to find and bring back jade crystals from creatures such as Fline, Liele, Satyr etc. that inhabit the Enchanted Valley.

name: Carson's Request
description: A request to recover the works of the ancient sculptor Berona from Hatar Ratmen and Vanor Silenos in the area near the Cemetery.

name: Knuckle Duster Edge
description: An essential ingredient needed by a Dwarf to make a Knuckle Duster. It can be bought from a regular store.

name: Avadon Shield Fragment
description: An essential ingredient needed by a Dwarf to make an Avadon Shield. It can be bought from a regular store.

name: Recipe: Knuckle Duster
description: For Dwarves only. The recipe for a Knuckle Duster. Requires Create Item - Skill Level 5. The success rate is 100%.

name: Recipe: Avadon Shield
description: For Dwarves only. The recipe for an Avadon Shield. Requires Create Item - Skill Level 6. The success rate is 100%.

name: Lottery Ticket
description: A lottery ticket from Aden, redeemable at any lottery sales location. Winning numbers are posted every Saturday at 7 p.m. You can't win if you don't play! Good luck!

name: Monster Race Ticket - Single
description: A winning ticket from the monster race. Redeemable at the cashier of the race.

name: Monster Race Ticket - Double
description: A winning daily double ticket from the monster race. Redeemable at the cashier of the race.

name: Blessed Scroll: Enchant Weapon (Grade A)
description: Increases the P.Atk of an A-Grade weapons such as sword/one-handed, blunt/one handed, dagger, spear and etc. type by 4. The P.Atk of sword/two-handed, blunt/two-handed, dual swords, and fists type will increase by 5 and bow type by 8. The M.Atk of all weapons will increase by 3. From +4, the added bonuses for P.Atk/M.Atk are double the above value. When fail on enchanting, item does not get crystallized but it's enchant value will return to 0.

name: Blessed Scroll: Enchant Armor (Grade A)
description: Increases the P. Def. of A-Grade armor or accessories by 1, and from +4, the P. Def will increase by 3. It can be safely enchanted up to +3. One-piece type armor can be safely enchanted up to +4. If one's attempt for enchanting fails, an item will not become crystallized.  However, the current enchant value will be set to 0.

description: A note that has cooking tips written by Donath.

name: Shaved Ice
description: Lilly's most favorite dessert that is made of a mixture of shaved ice and sweet flavorings.

name: Ice Cream
description: Sweet, soft and cold scoop of ice cream.

name: Ice Crystal Gemstone
description: When sunlight reflects on it, it shines brightly with a rainbow of colors.

name: Offering
description: Food that is dedicated to Saint Agnes.  It is tightly sealed to preserve its freshness.

name: Spinneret
description: A spider's anatomical structure from which spider web is produced.

name: Investigative Report
description: A document received from Information Broker Mist. It contains the results of an investigation requested by Magister Justin.

name: Investigative Report
description: A document received from Information Broker Mist. It contains the results of an investigation requested by Magister Alminas.

name: Investigative Report
description: A document received from Information Broker Mist. It contains the results of an investigation requested by Magister Kamilen.

name: Investigative Report
description: A document received from Information Broker Bavarin. It contains the results of an investigation requested by Guard Baird.

name: Investigative Report
description: A document received from Information Broker Mist. It contains the results of an investigation requested by High Priest Gregory.

name: Ice Cold Flower
description: An ice crystal that is wrapped in fish scales and emits cold, icy air. Since it is beautifully created with a highly skilled hand, it looks like a flower.

name: Pure Ice
description: A chunk of purest ice that is made by freezing purified water. It is known to contain the power of the gods from the beginning of the world.

name: Bitter Cold Beer
description: The beer requested by Blacksmith Feynn. Just touching it makes your hands feel like they are freezing.

name: Multiple Course Meal
description: An elaborate meal requested by the Arena Manager. It is said to be eaten by duelists in ancient times to strengthen their stamina the day before their match.

name: Dead Souls Fish Soup
description: A soup that is supposed to contain all the nutrition of the fish it is made from. According to legend, depending on the fish you use to make it, it can have the effect of increasing or decreasing one's lifespan.

name: Bitter Cold Vodka
description: A legendary liquor that is made by dipping hot flames into cold, freezing ice. Although it feels cold to the lips it becomes hot in one's body.

name: Silver Crystal
description: The type of crystal that is needed to store wedding march music.

name: Red Crystal
description: The type of crystal that is needed to store birthday party music.

name: Vampire's Heart
description: The heart that is ripped out of the body of a vampire.  It is still beating and pumping out blood.

name: Zombie's Brain
description: A piece of brain collected from an undead monster in the Forest of the Dead. It may contain the memory of the moment of its death.

name: Rib Bone of a Black Magus
description: The remaining bone that is left in the place where a necromancer died and disappeared. Perhaps it was used to transfix the shape of the necromancer.

name: Zombie's Liver
description: A liver that is rotting and emitting a strong stench.  It is known to be a source of magical power of undead.

name: Top Quality Meat
description: A piece of top quality meat that is obtained by slaughtering a wild beast of proper age.  Only one piece of this high quality meat can be obtained from one beast.

name: Young Wild Beast Meat
description: A piece of meat obtained by slaughtering a wild beast that is too young. Although it may have a pleasant aroma, it doesn't give good flavor when eating it.

name: Map Piece
description: A piece of a map that was once possessed by Monster Eyes.

name: Yellow Map
description: A map that contains a plot of the beasts. Take it to Mercenary Captain Sophya.

name: Map Piece
description: A piece of map obtained from the ghostly apparitions that haunt the Execution Groundss.

name: Ivory Colored Map
description: A map that contains strange information. By the way, sometime ago, Trader Galladucci complained that one of the maps he was supposed to receive didn't arrive...?

name: Broken Gemstone Fragment
description: A fragment of gemstone that can be obtained by hunting Maille Lizardmen.

name: Gold Colored Gemstone
description: A gold colored orb. High Priest Drikus is supposed to be looking for it.

name: Scroll of Escape to Talking Island
description: A magical scroll that relocates you to Talking Island.

name: Scroll of Escape to Elven Village
description: A magical scroll that relocates you to Elven Village.

name: Scroll of Escape to Dark Elf Village
description: A magical scroll that relocates you to Dark Elf Village.

name: Scroll of Escape to Orc Village
description: A magical scroll that relocates you to Orc Village.

name: Scroll of Escape to Dwarven Village
description: A magical scroll that relocates you to Dwarven Village.

name: Scroll of Escape to Giran Castle Town
description: A magical scroll that relocates you to Giran Castle Town.

name: Fishing Manual
description: An instructional book of fishing techniques. You can double-click it to read it.

name: Dimensional Diamond
description: A crystal that is filled with magical power. It is needed when casting Instant Move magic. If you collect this item and take them to a gatekeeper, you can trade them for various types of Scroll of Escape.

name: Galladucci's Orders (Document)
description: A document describing Galladucci's orders. Take it to Trader Gentler at his magic shop.

name: Galladucci's Orders (Document)
description: A document describing Galladucci's orders. Take it to Jeweler Sandra at her shop.

name: Galladucci's Orders (Document)
description: A document describing Galladucci's orders. Take it to Priest Dustin at his shop.

name: Purified Magic Necklace
description: It's the item given by Priest Dustin. It seems to be the item Trader Galladucci has been looking for.

name: Gemstone Powder
description: The item given by Trader Sandra. This seems to be the item Trader Galladucci has been looking for.

name: Magic Sword Hilt
description: An item given by Trader Gentler. This seems to be the item Trader Galladucci has been looking for.

name: Four-leaf Golden Clover Coin
description: A gold coin that is engraved with a four-leaf clover design.

name: Mark of Traveler
description: A certificate to prove to Trader Galladucci the identity of the traveler.

name: Baulro's Letter
description: The letter sent by Magister Baulro to Archon Sir Windawood.

name: Ariel's Recommendation
description: A letter of recommendation Trader Ariel wrote for you to be sent to Hierarch Asterios.

name: Roselyn's Note
description: A note Roselyn wrote while being angry and wrathful. You should deliver it to Magister Harne.

name: Very Expensive Necklace
description: A gift from Head Blacksmith Reed for Priest of the Earth Gerald. It looks very expensive.

name: Draconic Bow Shaft
description: Main ingredient essentially required for a Dwarf to make a Draconic Bow. Can also be sold at ordinary shops.

name: Recipe: Draconic Bow (60%)
description: For Dwarves only. The recipe for a Draconic Bow. Requires Create Item - Skill Level 9. The success rate is 60%.

name: Scroll: Enchant Weapon (Grade A)
description: When enchanted, the P. Atk. of  A-Grade weapons such as sword/one-handed, blunt weapon/one-handed, dagger and spear etc. will increase by 4.  The P. Atk of  sword/two-handed, blunt weapon/two-handed, dualsword, and fist-fighting weapon/two-handed will increase by 5. The P. Atk. of bow weapons will increase by 8. The M. Atk. of all weapons will increase by 3. From +4, P. Atk. and M. Atk. bonus will double for all weapon types.  It can be safely enchanted up to +3.

name: Blessed Scroll: Enchant Weapon (Grade A)
description: Increases the P.Atk of an A-Grade weapons such as sword/one-handed, blunt/one handed, dagger, spear and etc. type by 4. The P.Atk of sword/two-handed, blunt/two-handed, dual swords, and fists type will increase by 5 and bow type by 8. The M.Atk of all weapons will increase by 3. From +4, the added bonuses for P.Atk/M.Atk are double the above value. When fail on enchanting, item does not get crystallized but it's enchant value will return to 0.

name: Blessed Scroll: Enchant Armor (Grade A)
description: Increases the P. Def. of A-Grade armor or accessories by 1, and from +4, the P. Def will increase by 3. It can be safely enchanted up to +3. One-piece type armor can be safely enchanted up to +4. If one's attempt for enchanting fails, an item will not become crystallized.  However, the current enchant value will be set to 0.
